AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless event workflow: an AWS Step Functions state machine publishes custom events onto a
  custom Amazon EventBridge event bus, and an EventBridge rule on that bus forwards every event
  to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: serverless-events
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 24
    Description: >-
      Short, lowercase project identifier used to name the event bus, the debug log group, the
      event rule and the state machine.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for naming and tagging the resources in this stack.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Custom EventBridge event bus (producer destination)
  ##############################################################################
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs destination used for testing / debugging
  ##############################################################################
  DebugLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-debug'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by Step Functions to publish events on the custom bus
  ##############################################################################
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the Step Functions state machine to publish events to the custom event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsOnCustomEventBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutEventsOnCustomBusOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by EventBridge to deliver matched events to CloudWatch Logs
  ##############################################################################
  EventRuleLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the EventBridge rule to deliver matched events to the debug CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteEventsToDebugLogGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLogStreamAndPutLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${DebugLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # Step Functions producer state machine (publishes custom events via the
  # EventBridge AWS SDK service integration - no Lambda required)
  ##############################################################################
  EventProducerStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-event-producer'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Publishes a well-formed custom event onto the custom EventBridge event bus.",
          "StartAt": "PutCustomEvent",
          "States": {
            "PutCustomEvent": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:eventbridge:putEvents",
              "Parameters": {
                "Entries": [
                  {
                    "Source": "com.example.serverless.workflow",
                    "DetailType": "CustomEventCreated",
                    "Detail": "{\"project\":\"${ProjectName}\",\"environment\":\"${EnvironmentName}\",\"status\":\"published\"}",
                    "EventBusName": "${CustomEventBus}"
                  }
                ]
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # EventBridge rule on the custom bus: forward every event to CloudWatch Logs
  ##############################################################################
  AllEventsToLogsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-all-events-to-logs'
      Description: Forwards every event published on the custom event bus to the debug CloudWatch Logs log group.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        account:
          - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Targets:
        - Id: DebugCloudWatchLogsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DebugLogGroup.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRuleLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  CustomEventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus that receives the workflow events.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  CustomEventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  AllEventsToLogsRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule that forwards all events on the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !Ref AllEventsToLogsRule

  AllEventsToLogsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that forwards all events on the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt AllEventsToLogsRule.Arn

  DebugLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving the raw event JSON for testing and debugging.
    Value: !Ref DebugLogGroup

  EventProducerStateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events onto the bus.
    Value: !Ref EventProducerStateMachine

deploy_completed_resources: CustomEventBus | DebugLogGroup | EventRuleLogsRole | AllEventsToLogsRule | StateMachineRole | EventProducerStateMachine

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cloud WAN centralized outbound traffic inspection for a greenfield account.
  This template creates an AWS Cloud WAN global network and an AWS Cloud WAN core
  network configured with multi-Region edge locations, production and development
  segments, an inspection network function group, tag-matched attachment policies
  and segment actions that route traffic from both the production and development
  segments through the inspection VPC. Everything the template depends on (the
  global network, the core network, the inspection VPC, its subnets and the VPC
  attachment) is created inside this same template - there are no external
  VPC/subnet/security-group/AMI/key-pair references and no Parameters of
  AWS-specific infrastructure types.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudwan-inspection
    Description: Short project name used for resource tagging and export naming.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging and export naming.
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - dev
      - test
      - staging

  AdditionalEdgeRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Additional AWS Region that hosts a second Cloud WAN core network edge location.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region name such as us-west-2.

  InspectionVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the centralized inspection VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block such as 10.0.0.0/16.

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals
    - !Ref Environment
    - prod

Resources:
  #############################################################################
  # AWS Cloud WAN global network
  #############################################################################
  CloudWanGlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment} Cloud WAN global network for centralized outbound traffic inspection'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-global-network'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: network-team
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: networking

  #############################################################################
  # AWS Cloud WAN core network (policy holds segments, function groups,
  # attachment policies and segment actions)
  #############################################################################
  CloudWanCoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref CloudWanGlobalNetwork
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment} core network routing production and development traffic through inspection VPCs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-core-network'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: network-team
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: networking
      PolicyDocument:
        version: '2021.12'
        core-network-configuration:
          asn-ranges:
            - '64512-65534'
          vpn-ecmp-support: true
          edge-locations:
            - location: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              asn: 64512
              inside-cidr-blocks:
                - '100.64.0.0/16'
            - location: !Ref AdditionalEdgeRegion
              asn: 64513
              inside-cidr-blocks:
                - '100.65.0.0/16'
        segments:
          - name: production
            description: Production segment - attachments are isolated from each other and join without acceptance.
            isolate-attachments: true
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: development
            description: Development segment - attachments can reach each other and require acceptance.
            isolate-attachments: false
        network-function-groups:
          - name: inspection
            description: Inspection VPCs that provide centralized egress traffic inspection.
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            description: Attachments tagged domain=inspection join the inspection network function group.
            condition:
              type: tag-value-matches
              operator: equals
              key: domain
              value: inspection
            action:
              add-to-network-function-group: inspection
          - rule-number: 200
            description: Attachments tagged domain=production are associated to the production segment.
            condition:
              type: tag-value-matches
              operator: equals
              key: domain
              value: production
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: production
          - rule-number: 300
            description: Attachments tagged domain=development are associated to the development segment.
            condition:
              type: tag-value-matches
              operator: equals
              key: domain
              value: development
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: development
          - rule-number: 65535
            description: Default rule - unattached VPCs land in the development segment.
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: development
        segment-actions:
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: production
            share-with:
              - inspection
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: development
            share-with:
              - inspection

  #############################################################################
  # Centralized inspection VPC (created inside this template - no external VPC)
  #############################################################################
  InspectionVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref InspectionVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-inspection-vpc'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: network-team
        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: networking

  InspectionSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-inspection-subnet-a'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InspectionSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-inspection-subnet-b'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  #############################################################################
  # Attachment that carries the tag the attachment policy matches on
  # (domain=inspection) so it joins the inspection network function group.
  #############################################################################
  InspectionVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CloudWanCoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVpc}'
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnetA}'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnetB}'
      Options:
        ApplianceModeSupport: true
        Ipv6Support: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-inspection-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: network-team

Outputs:
  GlobalNetworkId:
    Description: ID of the AWS Cloud WAN global network.
    Value: !Ref CloudWanGlobalNetwork
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CloudWanGlobalNetworkId'

  CoreNetworkId:
    Description: ID of the AWS Cloud WAN core network.
    Value: !Ref CloudWanCoreNetwork
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CloudWanCoreNetworkId'

  CoreNetworkArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS Cloud WAN core network.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudWanCoreNetwork.CoreNetworkArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CloudWanCoreNetworkArn'

  InspectionVpcId:
    Description: ID of the centralized inspection VPC.
    Value: !Ref InspectionVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-InspectionVpcId'

  InspectionVpcAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the inspection VPC attachment to the Cloud WAN core network.
    Value: !Ref InspectionVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-InspectionVpcAttachmentId'

  PrimaryEdgeLocationRegion:
    Description: The stack Region used as the first Cloud WAN core network edge location.
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-PrimaryEdgeLocationRegion'

  AdditionalEdgeLocationRegion:
    Description: The additional Region used as the second Cloud WAN core network edge location.
    Value: !Ref AdditionalEdgeRegion
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-AdditionalEdgeLocationRegion'
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-705648ec' on localstack", 'iac-god-eval-705648ec: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'CloudWanGlobalNetwork: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'CloudWanGlobalNetwork: CREATE_COMPLETE - Resource type AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork is not supported but was deployed as a fallback', 'CloudWanCoreNetwork: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'CloudWanCoreNetwork: CREATE_COMPLETE - Resource type AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork is not supported but was deployed as a fallback', 'InspectionVpc: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'InspectionVpc: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'InspectionSubnetA: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'InspectionSubnetA: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'InspectionSubnetB: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'InspectionSubnetB: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'InspectionVpcAttachment: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'InspectionVpcAttachment: CREATE_COMPLETE - Resource type AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment is not supported but was deployed as a fallback', 'iac-god-eval-705648ec: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']

Description: >-

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions standard workflow that writes an item to DynamoDB and reads it back.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used by the state machine.

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBItemAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutAndGetItem
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Put an item into DynamoDB, then read it back by id.",
          "StartAt": "PutItem",
          "States": {
            "PutItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${TableName}",
                "Item": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "S.$": "States.Format('Item {} created', $.id)"
                  }
                }
              },
              "Next": "GetItem"
            },
            "GetItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${TableName}",
                "Key": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultSelector": {
                "item.$": "$.Item"
              },
              "OutputPath": "$.item",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the created DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref Table

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS DevOps Agent space together with the IAM roles used by the DevOps Agent
  service and by the operator application. The template configures the role trust
  relationships for the aidevops.amazonaws.com service principal, including
  aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn conditions, grants the required permissions through
  inline policies, allows the agent service role to create its service-linked role, and
  registers the current AWS account as the primary monitoring account for the agent space.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: DevOpsAgentSpace
    Description: Name of the AWS DevOps Agent space.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,48}[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Agent space names must be 3-50 characters long, begin and end with an alphanumeric
      character, and contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.

Resources:

  AgentSpaceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service to operate within the agent space.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent-space/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowDevOpsAgentMonitoringAccess
          PolicyDocument:

              - Sid: AllowOperatorAppIdentityAccess
                Effect: Allow

                  - iam:PassRole

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName

  AgentSpace:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    Value: !GetAtt OperatorAppRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment with CodeDeploy blue-green traffic
  shifting (canary) plus pre-traffic and post-traffic validation hook functions.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app
    Description: Logical application name used to derive resource names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,39}$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment name.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
  LogLevel:
    Type: String
    Default: INFO
    Description: Log level injected into the main function as a plain configuration value.
    AllowedValues:
      - DEBUG
      - INFO
      - WARNING
      - ERROR
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period (days) for the CloudWatch log group of every function.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch log groups (explicit, bounded retention)
  ###############################################################################

  MainFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BeforeAllowTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-before-allow-traffic'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AfterAllowTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-after-allow-traffic'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Main function execution role
  ###############################################################################

  MainFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the main application Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main-cloudwatch-logs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Main Lambda function, immutable version, and live alias
  ###############################################################################

  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main'
      Description: Main application function deployed with CodeDeploy blue-green traffic shifting.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              logger.info("Environment: %s", os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT", "unknown"))
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "ok"}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: !Sub 'Immutable version of ${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main'

  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version

  ###############################################################################
  # Pre-traffic validation hook (BeforeAllowTraffic)
  ###############################################################################

  BeforeAllowTrafficHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-before-role'
      Description: Execution role for the BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-before-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteHookLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-before-allow-traffic:*'
              - Sid: InspectDeployedAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetAlias
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main'
              - Sid: ReportLifecycleHookStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-app/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dg'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BeforeAllowTrafficHook:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-before-allow-traffic'
      Description: CodeDeploy BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt BeforeAllowTrafficHookRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
          HOOK_REGION: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
          HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
          TARGET_ALIAS_ARN: !Ref MainFunctionAlias
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")

          TARGET_ALIAS_ARN = os.environ["TARGET_ALIAS_ARN"]
          HOOK_REGION = os.environ["HOOK_REGION"]
          HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID = os.environ["HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID"]


          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event["DeploymentId"]
              hook_execution_id = event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"]
              status = "Succeeded"

              try:
                  logger.info(
                      "Pre-traffic validation in account %s region %s for alias %s",
                      HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID,
                      HOOK_REGION,
                      TARGET_ALIAS_ARN,
                  )
                  alias = lambda_client.get_alias(FunctionName=TARGET_ALIAS_ARN)
                  logger.info(
                      "Alias %s currently points to version %s",
                      alias["Name"],
                      alias["FunctionVersion"],
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.error("Pre-traffic validation failed: %s", exc)
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Post-traffic validation hook (AfterAllowTraffic)
  ###############################################################################

  AfterAllowTrafficHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-after-role'
      Description: Execution role for the AfterAllowTraffic validation hook.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-after-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteHookLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-after-allow-traffic:*'
              - Sid: InspectDeployedAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetAlias
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-main'
              - Sid: InvokeDeployedAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Ref MainFunctionAlias
              - Sid: ReportLifecycleHookStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-app/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dg'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AfterAllowTrafficHook:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-hook-after-allow-traffic'
      Description: CodeDeploy AfterAllowTraffic validation hook.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt AfterAllowTrafficHookRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LogLevel
          HOOK_REGION: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
          HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
          TARGET_ALIAS_ARN: !Ref MainFunctionAlias
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")

          TARGET_ALIAS_ARN = os.environ["TARGET_ALIAS_ARN"]
          HOOK_REGION = os.environ["HOOK_REGION"]
          HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID = os.environ["HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID"]


          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event["DeploymentId"]
              hook_execution_id = event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"]
              status = "Succeeded"

              try:
                  logger.info(
                      "Post-traffic validation in account %s region %s for alias %s",
                      HOOK_ACCOUNT_ID,
                      HOOK_REGION,
                      TARGET_ALIAS_ARN,
                  )
                  alias = lambda_client.get_alias(FunctionName=TARGET_ALIAS_ARN)
                  logger.info(
                      "Alias %s now serves version %s",
                      alias["Name"],
                      alias["FunctionVersion"],
                  )
                  response = lambda_client.invoke(
                      FunctionName=TARGET_ALIAS_ARN,
                      InvocationType="RequestResponse",
                      Payload=json.dumps({"source": "after-allow-traffic"}),
                  )
                  logger.info("Alias invocation status code: %s", response["StatusCode"])
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.error("Post-traffic validation failed: %s", exc)
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # CodeDeploy service role
  ###############################################################################

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-codedeploy-role'
      Description: Service role assumed by CodeDeploy to orchestrate Lambda blue-green deployments.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-codedeploy-lifecycle'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReportLifecycleHookStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-app/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dg'
              - Sid: InvokeValidationHooksAndAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BeforeAllowTrafficHook.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AfterAllowTrafficHook.Arn
                  - !Ref MainFunctionAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # CodeDeploy application and deployment group (Lambda, canary shifting)
  ###############################################################################

  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-app'
      ComputePlatform: Lambda
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-dg'
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:

  MainFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the main Lambda function (AppSpec "resources" target).
    Value: !Ref MainFunction

  MainFunctionAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the live alias that CodeDeploy shifts traffic to.
    Value: !Ref MainFunctionAlias

  BeforeAllowTrafficHookName:
    Description: Function name to use for the AppSpec BeforeAllowTraffic hook.
    Value: !Ref BeforeAllowTrafficHook

  BeforeAllowTrafficHookArn:
    Description: ARN of the BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt BeforeAllowTrafficHook.Arn

  AfterAllowTrafficHookName:
    Description: Function name to use for the AppSpec AfterAllowTraffic hook.
    Value: !Ref AfterAllowTrafficHook

  AfterAllowTrafficHookArn:
    Description: ARN of the AfterAllowTraffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt AfterAllowTrafficHook.Arn

  CodeDeployApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the CodeDeploy application (used by CreateDeployment).
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployApplication

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroupName:

        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  PCIEncryptionKeyAlias:

    Properties:

      TargetKeyId: !Ref PCIEncryptionKey

  PCIRemediationNotifications:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PCI Compliance Remediation Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref PCIEncryptionKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: PCIComplianceRemediation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  PCIAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by the PCI compliance SSM Automation remediation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmEc2AndEventsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pciautomationassumerolepolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PciAutomationEc2Remediation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PciAutomationAutoScalingRemediation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: '*'

  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupTrafficDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupTraffic
      DocumentType: Automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: PCIComplianceRemediation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes every inbound and outbound rule from the default security group so the VPC default group denies all traffic.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          automationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes when running this document.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: VPC whose default security group is restricted. Leave empty to process the default security group of every VPC in the region.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: restrictDefaultSecurityGroupTraffic
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: scriptHandler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def scriptHandler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = (events.get('VpcId') or '').strip()

                    filters = [{'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}]
                    if vpc_id:
                        filters.append({'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]})

                    groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(Filters=filters)['SecurityGroups']

                    total_ingress = 0
                    total_egress = 0
                    processed = []

                    for group in groups:
                        group_id = group['GroupId']
                        ingress_rules = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                        egress_rules = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])

                        if ingress_rules:
                            ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                                GroupId=group_id,
                                IpPermissions=ingress_rules
                            )
                            total_ingress += len(ingress_rules)

                        if egress_rules:
                            ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                                GroupId=group_id,
                                IpPermissions=egress_rules
                            )
                            total_egress += len(egress_rules)

                        processed.append({
                            'GroupId': group_id,
                            'GroupName': group.get('GroupName', ''),
                            'VpcId': group.get('VpcId', ''),
                            'IngressRulesRevoked': len(ingress_rules),
                            'EgressRulesRevoked': len(egress_rules)
                        })

                    return {
                        'GroupCount': len(processed),
                        'TotalIngressRulesRevoked': total_ingress,
                        'TotalEgressRulesRevoked': total_egress,
                        'DefaultSecurityGroups': processed
                    }

  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
      DocumentType: Automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: PCIComplianceRemediation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes security groups that are not attached to any network interface and are not referenced by another security group, skipping VPC default groups.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          automationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes when running this document.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: VPC to scan for unused security groups. Leave empty to scan every VPC in the region.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: scriptHandler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def scriptHandler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = (events.get('VpcId') or '').strip()

                    if vpc_id:
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            Filters=[{'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                        )['SecurityGroups']
                        scope = vpc_id
                    else:
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups()['SecurityGroups']
                        scope = 'all-vpcs'

                    referenced_group_ids = set()
                    for group in groups:
                        rules = list(group.get('IpPermissions', []))
                        rules = rules + list(group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', []))
                        for rule in rules:
                            for pair in rule.get('UserIdGroupPairs', []):
                                referenced_id = pair.get('GroupId')
                                if referenced_id and referenced_id != group['GroupId']:
                                    referenced_group_ids.add(referenced_id)

                    attached_group_ids = set()
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_network_interfaces')
                    if vpc_id:
                        pages = paginator.paginate(
                            Filters=[{'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                        )
                    else:
                        pages = paginator.paginate()
                    for page in pages:
                        for eni in page.get('NetworkInterfaces', []):
                            for eni_group in eni.get('Groups', []):
                                attached_group_ids.add(eni_group['GroupId'])

                    deleted = []
                    retained = []

                    for group in groups:
                        group_id = group['GroupId']
                        group_name = group.get('GroupName', '')

                        if group_name == 'default':
                            retained.append({
                                'GroupId': group_id,
                                'Reason': 'VPC default security group is never deleted'
                            })
                            continue

                        if group_id in attached_group_ids:
                            retained.append({
                                'GroupId': group_id,
                                'Reason': 'Security group is attached to a network interface'
                            })
                            continue

                        if group_id in referenced_group_ids:
                            retained.append({
                                'GroupId': group_id,
                                'Reason': 'Security group is referenced by another security group'
                            })
                            continue

                        try:
                            ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                            deleted.append({
                                'GroupId': group_id,
                                'GroupName': group_name,
                                'Reason': 'Unused security group deleted'
                            })
                        except Exception as error:
                            retained.append({
                                'GroupId': group_id,
                                'Reason': 'Deletion failed: {0}'.format(error)
                            })

                    return {
                        'Scope': scope,
                        'DeletedCount': len(deleted),
                        'RetainedCount': len(retained),
                        'DeletedGroups': deleted,
                        'RetainedGroups': retained
                    }

  ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
      DocumentType: Automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: PCIComplianceRemediation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases Elastic IP addresses that are not associated with any resource, using the supplied allocation IDs.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          automationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes when running this document.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
          AllocationIds:
            type: String
            description: Comma-delimited list of Elastic IP allocation IDs to release (for example eipalloc-0123456789abcdef0,eipalloc-0fedcba9876543210).
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseUnassociatedElasticIps
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: scriptHandler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationIds: '{{ AllocationIds }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def scriptHandler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    raw_value = events.get('AllocationIds') or ''

                    if isinstance(raw_value, list):
                        allocation_ids = [
                            str(item).strip() for item in raw_value if str(item).strip()
                        ]
                    else:
                        allocation_ids = [
                            item.strip() for item in str(raw_value).split(',') if item.strip()
                        ]

                    if not allocation_ids:
                        raise ValueError(
                            'At least one Elastic IP allocation ID is required.'
                        )

                    addresses = {}
                    for address in ec2.describe_addresses()['Addresses']:
                        allocation_id = address.get('AllocationId')
                        if allocation_id:
                            addresses[allocation_id] = address

                    released = []
                    skipped = []

                    for allocation_id in allocation_ids:
                        address = addresses.get(allocation_id)

                        if address is None:
                            skipped.append({
                                'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                                'Reason': 'Allocation ID was not found in this region'
                            })
                            continue

                        if address.get('AssociationId'):
                            skipped.append({
                                'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                                'Reason': 'Address is still associated with {0}'.format(
                                    address.get('AssociationId')
                                )
                            })
                            continue

                        ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                        released.append({
                            'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                            'PublicIp': address.get('PublicIp', '')
                        })

                    return {
                        'ReleasedCount': len(released),
                        'SkippedCount': len(skipped),
                        'ReleasedAddresses': released,
                        'SkippedAddresses': skipped
                    }

  UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Ear Hustle production DNS stack. Creates a Route53 public hosted zone for the parameterized
  apex domain (default: earhustlesq.com) and provisions the complete production record set:
  SPF, Google/Zoom/ZenDesk site-verification, DMARC and ATProto TXT records, Google Workspace
  (G Suite) MX records for both the apex and the legacy subdomain, Squarespace A/www/domain
  verification records, podcast feed CNAMEs, ZenDesk, Campaign Monitor, Google Workspace and
  Supercast DKIM records, plus a self-contained ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain. The
  certificate uses DNS validation with the Route53 hosted zone supplied directly, so ACM creates
  and manages the validation record automatically with no manual intervention.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    Description: Apex domain name for the Ear Hustle production Route53 hosted zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid lowercase DNS domain name, for example earhustlesq.com.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # Hosted zone
  ############################################################################

  EarHustleHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Ear Hustle production hosted zone
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  ############################################################################
  # Apex TXT records (SPF, Google, Zoom and ZenDesk verification consolidated
  # into a single TXT record set - duplicate name/type pairs are not allowed)
  ############################################################################

  ApexTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:_spf.createsend.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:spf.supercast.com ~all"'
        - '"google-site-verification=lR2kQ9v3XbZ1sT7pWmVh0aYeJdKfGq8cNx5uRzLbP4o"'
        - '"zoom-site-verification=Zm9vYmFyMTIzNDU2Nzg5MGFiY2RlZmdoaWprbG1u"'
        - '"zendesk-verification=zdv-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"'

  DmarcTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@${DomainName}; fo=1"'

  AtProtoTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_atproto.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"did=did:plc:5fzq2vx7k3mnpqrstuvwxyza"'

  ############################################################################
  # Google Workspace (G Suite) mail - apex and legacy subdomain
  ############################################################################

  ApexMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

  OldSubdomainTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'old.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  OldSubdomainMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'old.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

  ############################################################################
  # Squarespace website records
  ############################################################################

  ApexARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '198.185.159.144'
        - '198.185.159.145'
        - '198.49.23.144'
        - '198.49.23.145'

  WwwCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'ext-sq.squarespace.com'

  SquarespaceVerificationCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'verify.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'verify.squarespace.com'

  ############################################################################
  # Podcast feeds
  ############################################################################

  FeedsCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'feeds.prx.org'

  ############################################################################
  # ZenDesk
  ############################################################################

  ZendeskDkimCnameRecordSet1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'zendesk1.domainkey.zendesk.com'

  ZendeskDkimCnameRecordSet2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'zendesk2.domainkey.zendesk.com'

  ZendeskDomainValidationCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'support.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'earhustle.zendesk.com'

  ############################################################################
  # Campaign Monitor
  ############################################################################

  CampaignMonitorDkimCnameRecordSet1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'cm.domainkey.createsend.com'

  CampaignMonitorDkimCnameRecordSet2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'cm2.domainkey.createsend.com'

  CampaignMonitorSendingSpfTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'send.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'

  CampaignMonitorSendingMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'send.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '10 mail.createsend.com.'

  ############################################################################
  # Google Workspace DKIM (public key only - never a private key)
  ############################################################################

  GoogleWorkspaceDkimTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQC8kZ0mP3tR1vX5yB7cD9eF2gH4iJ6kL8mN0oP2qR4sT6uV8wX0yZ2aB4cD6eF8gH0iJ2kL4mN6oP8qR0sT2uV4wX6yZ8aB0cD2eF4gH6iJ8kL0mN2oP4qR6sT8uV0wX2yZ4QIDAQAB"'

  ############################################################################
  # Supercast (DKIM selector and return-path)
  ############################################################################

  SupercastDkimCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'supercast._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'supercast.domainkey.supercast.com'

  SupercastReturnPathCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'mail.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'mail.supercast.com'

  ############################################################################
  # ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain.
  # Provisioned in the region this stack is deployed to (it is NOT intended for
  # a CloudFront distribution, which would require us-east-1). DNS validation is
  # fully self-contained: supplying HostedZoneId causes ACM to create and manage
  # the validation CNAME record in the hosted zone automatically, so no manual
  # validation record or action is required.
  ############################################################################

  EarHustleFeedsCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
          HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route53 hosted zone ID for the Ear Hustle production domain.
    Value: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone

  HostedZoneName:
    Description: Domain name of the Ear Hustle production hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref DomainName

  HostedZoneNameServers:
    Description: Authoritative name servers for the hosted zone (configure these at the registrar).
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt EarHustleHostedZone.NameServers]

  FeedsCertificateArn:
    Description: ARN of the ACM certificate issued for the feeds subdomain.
    Value: !Ref EarHustleFeedsCertificate

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Fully self-contained multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard stack. Creates an Amazon ECR
  repository for the container image, an App Runner build/access IAM role (ECR image pull),
  an App Runner task/instance IAM role (AWS Directory Service + Amazon QuickSight tenant
  provisioning), and an AWS App Runner service with auto-deployments enabled, a /status
  health check on port 8080, and runtime environment variables for the QuickSight
  integration. GREENFIELD IMAGE DEPENDENCY: the newly created ECR repository is empty, so a
  container image must be built and pushed to it (for example by a CodeBuild/CodePipeline
  project or an external CI step) before or as part of the first deployment; App Runner will
  fail to create a service that points at a nonexistent image tag. Image tags are immutable
  to prevent image mutation; each deployment must push a uniquely tagged image and the
  AppRunnerImageTag parameter selects which tag the service pulls.

Parameters:
  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Non-secret admin user name passed to the application as a runtime environment variable.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen or at-sign.

  DummyEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    Description: Non-secret placeholder email address used by the application for tenant/user setup.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 254
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a syntactically valid, non-secret email placeholder.

  TenantTemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-tenant-template
    Description: Non-secret QuickSight template identifier used for tenant provisioning.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  TenantDataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-tenant-dataset
    Description: Non-secret QuickSight data set identifier used for tenant provisioning.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  TenantDataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-tenant-datasource
    Description: Non-secret QuickSight data source identifier used for tenant provisioning.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_db
    Description: Non-secret database name used by the QuickSight data source.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_table
    Description: Non-secret table name used by the QuickSight data set.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  FilterColumnName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_id
    Description: Non-secret filter column used for row-level multi-tenant filtering in QuickSight.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  AppRunnerImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: latest
    Description: Container image tag in the immutable ECR repository that the App Runner service pulls.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid Docker image tag.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon ECR repository that holds the multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard image.
  # Image tags are IMMUTABLE to prevent code injection through image mutation;
  # each deployment must push a uniquely tagged image. The repository starts
  # empty in a greenfield account: build and push an image (CI/CD, CodeBuild, or
  # local docker push) before the App Runner service is created, otherwise
  # service creation fails on the missing image tag.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QuickSightDashboardRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: quicksight-multitenant-dashboard
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # App Runner build/access role: used by the App Runner service to pull the
  # private container image from the ECR repository created above.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppRunnerEcrAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerBuildToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: App Runner build/access role used to pull images from the QuickSight dashboard ECR repository.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppRunnerEcrImagePullPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrGetAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrRepositoryImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                Resource: !GetAtt QuickSightDashboardRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: quicksight-apprunner-ecr-access-role
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # App Runner task/instance role: assumed by the running application container
  # for AWS Directory Service and Amazon QuickSight tenant provisioning.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppRunnerTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerTasksToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: App Runner task role granting AWS Directory Service and Amazon QuickSight tenant provisioning permissions.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DirectoryServiceTenantProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceTenantProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
