final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark - VPC flow logging control. Self-contained AWS Systems Manager
  Automation solution that enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT (rejected traffic) capture on a
  VPC supplied at automation runtime, delivering to an encrypted, long-retention CloudWatch
  Logs log group. Includes a direct remediation runbook and a Change Manager front-door runbook
  so that any real-world use of the flow log fix goes through formal change approval.

Metadata:
  Comment: >-
    Self-contained template intended for a greenfield account: every resource it depends on is
    created here (CloudWatch Logs log group, KMS key and alias, VPC flow-logs delivery role,
    automation execution role, and both SSM Automation documents). No external VPC, subnet, key
    pair, secret, SSM parameter, or imported stack output is referenced. The VPC that gets
    remediated is supplied at automation runtime as an input parameter of the SSM Automation
    documents; it is intentionally NOT a CloudFormation parameter of type AWS::EC2::VPC::Id and
    never appears as a literal vpc-xxxxxxxx value.
  ExecutionModel: >-
    Change Manager approvals are the sanctioned execution path for this control. Operators invoke
    EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectViaChangeManager-<stack name>, which raises an AWS Systems Manager
    Change Manager change request for the target VPC. Only after approval is granted does the
    delegated EnableVpcFlowLogsReject-<stack name> runbook perform the remediation. The direct
    runbook exists for break-glass/testing use only.
  ChangeManagerPrerequisite: >-
    CloudFormation has no resource type for Change Manager change templates or for approver lists,
    so those cannot be created by this template. A Change Manager change template (with its
    approver list, notification settings, and the account/Region Change Manager configuration)
    must pre-exist and be selected at automation runtime. This prerequisite is documented here
    instead of fabricating a non-existent resource type such as AWS::ChangeManager::*.
  ApiUncertaintyNote: >-
    The Change Manager front-door step calls the documented Systems Manager API action
    ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution through aws:executeAwsApi rather than a Change Manager-specific
    Automation action, because the API action is the documented, version-stable interface. The way
    a change template is supplied to Change Manager (change-template document name versus runbook
    list) varies with the API version and with the account's Change Manager configuration; if your
    configuration requires an explicit change template, supply it at runtime when creating the
    change request. Document #2 never targets itself (no recursion) and never calls
    ec2:CreateFlowLogs - it only delegates to document #1 after approval.
  ResourceGraphNote: >-
    The resource graph is acyclic: KMS key and alias stand alone, the log group depends on the KMS
    key, the delivery role depends on the log group and the KMS key, the automation execution role
    depends on the log group, the KMS key and the delivery role, and the two SSM Automation
    documents depend on those resources (document #2 references document #1 by Ref for an implicit
    dependency). No resource in the template references the SSM documents, so there is no Ref or
    GetAtt cycle.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cis-vpc-flowlogs
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start with a letter or number.'
    Description: 'Lowercase prefix used to derive resource names for this CIS VPC flow-logging solution.'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
    Description: 'Deployment environment used for resource tagging.'
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3653
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: >-
      CloudWatch Logs retention in days for the VPC flow-log destination. The default of 3653 days
      (10 years) satisfies compliance-grade retention requirements; only valid CloudWatch Logs
      retention values are accepted.

Conditions: {}

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key + alias protecting the VPC flow-log destination at rest.
  # The log-group ARN used in the key policy is built from pseudo-parameters and
  # the NamePrefix parameter (instead of Ref-ing the log group) so that the log
  # group can depend on the key without creating a circular dependency.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) delivered to CloudWatch Logs by ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # Root/deploying account retains full key administration so the key is never orphaned.
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          # CloudWatch Logs may use the key only for this stack's flow-log log group
          # (confused-deputy protection through the encryption context and SourceArn/SourceAccount).
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKeyForVpcFlowLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}/${AWS::StackName}'
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}/${AWS::StackName}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs-key-${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}/vpc-flowlogs-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs destination for VPC flow logs (REJECT traffic).
  # Holds compliance data, therefore Retain on delete and on replacement.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}/${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC flow-logs delivery role: assumed by the VPC Flow Logs service to publish
  # records into the log group above, and (per the mixed-trust requirement) also
  # assumable by Systems Manager. Confused-deputy conditions are applied on both
  # trusted principals because a mixed trust policy must not be abusable.
  # NOTE: logs:CreateLogGroup is deliberately NOT granted - the log group is
  # created by this template, so the delivery role only ever writes to it.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs-delivery-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Delivery role assumed by VPC Flow Logs (delivery.logs.amazonaws.com) to publish REJECT flow logs into the encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, and by Systems Manager for related automation.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsDeliveryService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                # SourceArn scoped to this stack's flow-log destination log group.
                # If a calling service presents the flow-log resource ARN instead,
                # broaden this to the ec2 vpc-flow-log ARN pattern for that account.
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}/${AWS::StackName}:*'
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: UseKmsKeyForFlowLogEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs-delivery-${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation execution role: assumed by Systems Manager Automation to run the
  # remediation steps and to raise Change Manager change requests.
  # iam:PassRole on the delivery role is required because ec2:CreateFlowLogs
  # receives DeliverLogsPermissionArn and EC2 then assumes that role.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs-automation-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Execution role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation to enable REJECT-traffic VPC Flow Logs and to route remediation through Change Manager approval.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEc2FlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CreateAndDescribeCloudWatchLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageRetentionOnFlowLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: StartAndInspectAutomationAndChangeRequests
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsDeliveryRoleToEc2
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs-automation-${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation document #1 - direct remediation.
  # Accepts a VPC ID at runtime and idempotently enables REJECT-traffic flow
  # logging to the encrypted log group via a Python 3.12 script (default boto3
  # credential chain - no embedded credentials, keys, or secrets).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'EnableVpcFlowLogsReject-${AWS::StackName}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'EnableVpcFlowLogsReject-${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark - VPC
          flow logging control) on a VPC supplied at runtime, delivering records to the encrypted,
          long-retention CloudWatch Logs log group created by this stack. The step is idempotent:
          an equivalent REJECT flow log to the same log group is detected and re-runs are no-ops.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: 'ARN of the automation execution role that Systems Manager assumes to run the steps (see the AutomationExecutionRoleArn output).'
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'ID of the VPC to enable REJECT flow logging on.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableRejectFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Idempotently enable REJECT-traffic VPC Flow Logs to the compliance log group.'
            assumedRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: enable_reject_flow_logs
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
                KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
                MaxAggregationInterval: '60'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError


                def enable_reject_flow_logs(events, context):
                    """Idempotently enable VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECT traffic for a VPC.

                    Uses the default boto3 credential chain (the credentials supplied by the
                    step's assumedRole). No credentials, keys or secrets are embedded here.
                    """
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    deliver_role_arn = events['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']
                    # Echoed for traceability only: CloudWatch Logs encryption at rest is
                    # configured on the log group itself (KmsKeyId), ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                    # does not take a KMS key parameter.
                    kms_key_arn = events.get('KmsKeyArn', '')
                    max_interval = int(events.get('MaxAggregationInterval', '60'))

                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    # Idempotency check: look for an existing equivalent REJECT flow log
                    # on this VPC already delivering to the same log group.
                    try:
                        existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                            Filters=[
                                {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                                {'Name': 'traffic-type', 'Values': ['REJECT']},
                            ]
                        ).get('FlowLogs', [])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to describe existing flow logs for {}: {}'.format(vpc_id, error)
                        )

                    for flow_log in existing:
                        if (flow_log.get('LogDestinationType') == 'cloud-watch-logs'
                                and flow_log.get('LogGroupName') == log_group_name
                                and flow_log.get('FlowLogStatus') != 'FAILED'):
                            return {
                                'VpcId': vpc_id,
                                'LogGroupName': log_group_name,
                                'KmsKeyArn': kms_key_arn,
                                'FlowLogId': flow_log.get('FlowLogId', ''),
                                'FlowLogStatus': flow_log.get('FlowLogStatus', ''),
                                'Created': False,
                                'Message': 'Equivalent REJECT flow log {} already delivers to {}; no action taken.'.format(
                                    flow_log.get('FlowLogId', ''), log_group_name)
                            }

                    try:
                        response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                            ResourceType='VPC',
                            ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                            TrafficType='REJECT',
                            LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                            LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                            DeliverLogsPermissionArn=deliver_role_arn,
                            MaxAggregationInterval=max_interval
                        )
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'ec2:CreateFlowLogs failed for {}: {}'.format(vpc_id, error)
                        )

                    flow_log_ids = response.get('FlowLogIds', [])
                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])

                    if not flow_log_ids:
                        return {
                            'VpcId': vpc_id,
                            'LogGroupName': log_group_name,
                            'KmsKeyArn': kms_key_arn,
                            'FlowLogId': '',
                            'FlowLogStatus': 'FAILED',
                            'Created': False,
                            'Message': 'ec2:CreateFlowLogs returned no flow log ID. Unsuccessful: {}'.format(
                                unsuccessful)
                        }

                    return {
                        'VpcId': vpc_id,
                        'LogGroupName': log_group_name,
                        'KmsKeyArn': kms_key_arn,
                        'FlowLogId': flow_log_ids[0],
                        'FlowLogStatus': 'ACTIVE',
                        'Created': True,
                        'Message': 'Enabled REJECT-traffic flow logging on {} to {} with MaxAggregationInterval={}s.'.format(
                            vpc_id, log_group_name, max_interval)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogId
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogId
                Type: String
              - Name: FlowLogStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogStatus
                Type: String
              - Name: Created
                Selector: $.Payload.Created
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: Message
                Selector: $.Payload.Message
                Type: String

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation document #2 - Change Manager front door.
  # This is the runbook operators should invoke: it raises a Change Manager
  # change request for the target VPC and delegates execution to document #1
  # (referenced by !Ref, which creates the implicit dependency - no DependsOn).
  # It never calls ec2:CreateFlowLogs and never targets itself.
  # Change Manager change templates/approver lists cannot be created by
  # CloudFormation and must pre-exist (see the template Metadata comment).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectViaChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectViaChangeManager-${AWS::StackName}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectViaChangeManager-${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs
      Content:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API (API Gateway V2) that asynchronously starts an AWS
  Step Functions standard state machine which, after a five second wait, posts a
  response back to the originating WebSocket connection via the API Gateway
  Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage used by the deployment and the callback.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by API Gateway to start the state machine execution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'states:StartExecution'
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by Step Functions to post back to the WebSocket client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'execute-api:ManageConnections'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/POST/@connections/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard Step Functions state machine: Wait 5s -> invoke APIGW management
  # API -> Succeed
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
          "States": {
            "WaitFiveSeconds": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "PostToConnection"
            },
            "PostToConnection": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::apigateway:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "ApiEndpoint": "https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com",
                "Method": "POST",
                "Stage": "${StageName}",
                "Path.$": "States.Format('/@connections/{}', $.connectionId)",
                "AuthType": "NONE",
                "RequestBody": {
                  "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "message.$": "$.message",
                  "status": "OK"
                }
              },
              "Next": "Succeeded"
            },
            "Succeeded": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway -> Step Functions StartExecution integration ($default route)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StartExecutionIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub |
          {
            "input": "{\"connectionId\":\"$context.connectionId\",\"message\":\"$input.body\"}",
            "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
          }

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${StartExecutionIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deployment and stage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn: DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Deployment of the WebSocket API routes

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: WebSocket API stage used for the callback URL

Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WSS URL for the deployed WebSocket API stage
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: Identifier of the created WebSocket API
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled, event-driven account-closure workflow. An Amazon EventBridge rule runs every hour and
  starts an EXPRESS AWS Step Functions state machine that paginates through every account in the
  AWS Organization and, only for accounts tagged "organizations:account-closure" = "REQUESTED",
  describes each account and closes it with the AWS Organizations CloseAccount API when its status
  is ACTIVE, then re-tags the account as "ACKNOWLEDGED" so it is not processed again on the next
  run. Closing an AWS Organizations account is irreversible and the "organizations:" tag prefix is
  reserved, so only the management account (or a delegated administrator) can set the trigger tag.
  All execution data is delivered to a CloudWatch Logs log group with 365-day retention.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs destination for the Express workflow execution data
  ###############################################################################

  AccountClosureLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vendedlogs/states/account-closure-workflow
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AccountClosureWorkflow
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AutomatedOrganizationsAccountClosure

  AccountClosureLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: account-closure-workflow-log-delivery
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AllowStepFunctionsLogDelivery",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Service": "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com" },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": [
                "${AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              ],
              "Condition": {
                "StringEquals": {
                  "aws:SourceAccount": "${AWS::AccountId}"
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM role used by the state machine (least privilege)
  ###############################################################################

  AccountClosureExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-workflow-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Least-privilege execution role for the EXPRESS account-closure state machine. Allows only
        the Organizations read/tag/close actions required by the workflow plus the CloudWatch Logs
        delivery permissions that Express workflows require, and X-Ray tracing.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosureActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrganizationsAccountClosure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ExpressWorkflowLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayExecutionTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AccountClosureWorkflow
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AutomatedOrganizationsAccountClosure

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM role used by EventBridge to start the state machine
  ###############################################################################

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-workflow-eventbridge-role
      Description: >-
        Allows the hourly Amazon EventBridge rule to start the account-closure Express state
        machine only.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartExpressStateMachine
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AccountClosureWorkflow
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AutomatedOrganizationsAccountClosure

  ###############################################################################
  # Express state machine: paginate, filter by tag, describe, close, tag
  ###############################################################################

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn:
      - AccountClosureLogGroupPolicy
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: account-closure-workflow
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Scheduled account-closure workflow. Paginates through every AWS Organizations account, proceeds only for accounts tagged 'organizations:account-closure' = 'REQUESTED', verifies status with DescribeAccount, closes ACTIVE accounts with CloseAccount and then re-tags them 'ACKNOWLEDGED'. Closing an AWS Organizations account is irreversible and the 'organizations:account-closure' tag is a reserved organizations:-prefixed key that only the management account or a delegated administrator may set.",
          "StartAt": "ListAccountsPage",
          "States": {
            "ListAccountsPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Comment": "List the first page of accounts in the organization.",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:ListAccounts",
              "Parameters": {
                "MaxResults": 20
              },
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                  "Next": "RecordWorkflowFailure"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsPage"
            },
            "ProcessAccountsPage": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "Comment": "Evaluate every account returned on the current page.",
              "ItemsPath": "$.Accounts",
              "MaxConcurrency": 1,
              "ItemProcessor": {
                "ProcessorConfig": {
                  "Mode": "INLINE"
                },
                "StartAt": "GetAccountTags",
                "States": {
                  "GetAccountTags": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Comment": "Read the account tags so the reserved closure tag can be evaluated.",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:ListTagsForResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.TagsResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountProcessingFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "FilterForClosureTag"
                  },
                  "FilterForClosureTag": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Comment": "Proceed only when the reserved closure tag equals REQUESTED. All other accounts are skipped with no side effects.",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.TagsResult.Tags[?(@.Key=='organizations:account-closure')].Value",
                        "StringEquals": "REQUESTED",
                        "Next": "DescribeAccountState"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "SkipAccountNotTagged"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccountState": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Comment": "Describe the account to confirm its status before closing.",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:DescribeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.DescribeResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountProcessingFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "CheckAccountStatus"
                  },
                  "CheckAccountStatus": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Comment": "Only ACTIVE accounts may be closed; SUSPENDED or PENDING_CLOSURE accounts are routed to a no-op branch.",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.DescribeResult.Account.Status",
                        "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                        "Next": "CloseAccountState"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "SkipAccountNotActive"
                  },
                  "CloseAccountState": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Comment": "Irreversible: closes the AWS Organizations account.",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:CloseAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.CloseResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountProcessingFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "TagAccountAcknowledged"
                  },
                  "TagAccountAcknowledged": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Comment": "Mark the closure request as ACKNOWLEDGED so the account is not re-processed on the next hourly run.",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:TagResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Tags": [
                        {
                          "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                          "Value": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "ResultPath": null,
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountProcessingFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "AccountClosed"
                  },
                  "AccountClosed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Result": "CLOSED_AND_ACKNOWLEDGED"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipAccountNotTagged": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Comment": "No-op branch: the account does not carry the closure request tag.",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Result": "SKIPPED_NOT_TAGGED_FOR_CLOSURE"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipAccountNotActive": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Comment": "No-op branch: the account is not ACTIVE so it must not be closed.",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Result": "SKIPPED_NOT_ACTIVE",
                      "AccountStatus.$": "$.DescribeResult.Account.Status"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "AccountProcessingFailed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Comment": "Terminal failure state for a single account. Captures the error and cause in the state output so one bad account does not abort the paginated sweep.",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Result": "FAILED",
                      "Error.$": "$.Error"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultPath": null,
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                  "Next": "RecordWorkflowFailure"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "CheckForNextToken"
            },
            "CheckForNextToken": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Comment": "Paginate: continue while ListAccounts returned a NextToken.",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.NextToken",
                  "IsPresent": true,
                  "Next": "ListAccountsNextPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "WorkflowComplete"
            },
            "ListAccountsNextPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Comment": "List the next page of accounts in the organization.",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:ListAccounts",
              "Parameters": {
                "MaxResults": 20,
                "NextToken.$": "$.NextToken"
              },
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                  "Next": "RecordWorkflowFailure"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsPage"
            },
            "RecordWorkflowFailure": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Capture the error and cause in the execution output before terminating.",
              "Parameters": {

  ###############################################################################

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened
  Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 (Graviton) AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk
  compatibility. The stack creates its own VPC, subnet, internet gateway,
  restricted-egress security group, a customer managed KMS key, IAM roles and
  instance profile, image recipe, build component, infrastructure
  configuration, distribution configuration and a lifecycle policy that deletes
  images older than 180 days. Vulnerability scanning is enabled through the
  pipeline's ImageScanningConfiguration, which delegates AMI scanning to Amazon
  Inspector. The AMI is distributed to the current Region and launch permissions
  are shared with an AWS Organization and a list of dummy dev/prod account IDs.

# ===========================================================================
# BUILD-TIME NOTES (documentation only - not suppressions/workarounds):
#
#   * PARENT IMAGE RISK: The EC2 Image Builder managed parent image
#       cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi
#     with the "x.x.x" version wildcard MUST resolve in the target Region when
#     the image recipe is created. Image Builder resolves the "x.x.x" wildcard
#     to the newest matching version of that managed image.
#     If the managed image is not available in the Region, recipe creation (and
#     therefore the pipeline) will fail. The correct remediation is a corrected
#     managed-image ARN/name, NEVER a hardcoded AMI ID.
#
#   * VULNERABILITY SCANNING: AMI scanning is enabled via the pipeline's
#     ImageScanningConfiguration. EC2 Image Builder delegates the actual scan to
#     Amazon Inspector, so Inspector EC2 scanning must be enabled in this
#     account and Region for findings to be produced.
#
#   * OUTBOUND ACCESS: The build security group intentionally restricts egress
#     to the VPC CIDR range. Reaching public package repositories and AWS
#     service endpoints for a build must therefore be provided by the network
#     layer only via explicitly approved routes (for example a NAT gateway or
#     VPC endpoints) that are added per environment; the security group itself
#     never opens unrestricted egress.
#
#   * EXECUTION ROLE PERMISSIONS: Both the pipeline execution role and the
#     lifecycle policy execution role use in-line policies with the
#     least-privilege permissions Image Builder needs, instead of depending on
#     external AWS managed policy ARNs. This keeps the stack fully self
#     contained and deployable in any account/Region.
#
#   * The EC2 Image Builder service principal is imagebuilder.amazonaws.com;
#     that principal depends on the Image Builder service-linked role to invoke
#     the pipeline, while the pipeline itself assumes the execution role
#     (trusting ec2.amazonaws.com) to launch/terminate build instances, take
#     snapshots and distribute AMIs.
# ===========================================================================

Parameters:

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-abcdefghij
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID, for example o-abcdefghij.
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID whose member accounts are granted launch permission on
      the built AMI.

  TargetAccountIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: '111111111111,222222222222'
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of dummy AWS account IDs (dev and prod deployment
      environments) that are granted launch permission on the built AMI.

Resources:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key used for SNS notifications and the build bucket
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for EC2 Image Builder notifications and build artifacts
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAwsServicesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  BuildKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BuildKmsKey

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield - created entirely in this template)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build-time security group (egress only, scoped to the VPC CIDR range)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Egress-only security group used by EC2 Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within the VPC (AWS service and package endpoints)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM - build instance role / instance profile
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-instance-role'
      Description: Instance role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM - Image Builder pipeline execution role (self-contained inline policy)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-execution-role'
      Description: >-
        Execution role assumed by the Image Builder pipeline to create and
        terminate build instances, create snapshots and distribute AMIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-execution-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ImageBuilderWorkflowPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListImagePipelines
                  - imagebuilder:TagResource
                  - imagebuilder:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2BuildInstanceAndImagePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BuildNotificationsLogsAndEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - sns:Publish
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM - lifecycle policy execution role (separate from the pipeline role)
  # Uses a self-contained inline policy with only the permissions required to
  # enumerate, deregister and delete aged AMIs and their snapshots.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role'
      Description: >-
        Execution role assumed by the Image Builder lifecycle policy to delete
        aged AMIs and their associated snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ImageBuilderLifecyclePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetLifecyclePolicy
                  - imagebuilder:ListLifecyclePolicies
                  - imagebuilder:ListLifecycleExecutionResources
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:TagResource
                  - imagebuilder:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ImageAndSnapshotDeletionPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build notifications (encrypted with the customer managed key)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-notifications'
      DisplayName: EC2 Image Builder build notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BuildKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build artifact / log bucket (stateful - retained, encrypted with the CMK)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BuildKmsKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Shared
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: BuildType
          Value: CIS-L1-ARM64

  BuildArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BuildArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BuildArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder component - Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  EBCompatibilityComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-component'
      Description: >-
        Pre-configures the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image
        for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility (platform hook directories, SSM and
        CloudWatch agents and time synchronization prerequisites).
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
        description: >-
          Installs and configures Elastic Beanstalk platform hooks, the SSM and
          CloudWatch agents and required system prerequisites.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateElasticBeanstalkHookDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/enact
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/post
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/enact
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/restartappserver/enact
                    - mkdir -p /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - chmod 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks
              - name: InstallElasticBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install amazon-ssm-agent amazon-cloudwatch-agent chrony
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                    - systemctl enable amazon-cloudwatch-agent
                    - systemctl enable chronyd
                    - systemctl start chronyd
                    - dnf -y clean all
              - name: ValidateElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks
                    - test -d /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - echo "Elastic Beanstalk compatibility configuration complete."
      Tags:
        Project: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        Environment: Shared
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        BuildType: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipe - CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 parent image
  # ARM64/aarch64 is derived from the CIS ARM parent image; no Architecture
  # property is set on the recipe.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  HardenedImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-cis-al2023-arm64-recipe'
      Description: >-
        CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 (Graviton) base image
        pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk with a 50 GB encrypted root volume.
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref EBCompatibilityComponent
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Project: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        Environment: Shared
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        BuildType: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure configuration - ARM64/Graviton build instances
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: >-
        Build infrastructure for the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023
        ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk image.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m7g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref BuildNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        Project: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        Environment: Shared
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        BuildType: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration - current Region + launch permissions
  # Account-level launch permission is expressed with TargetAccountIds on the
  # AMI distribution configuration; organization-level sharing is expressed
  # with LaunchPermissionConfiguration.OrganizationArns.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: >-
        Distributes the hardened AMI to the current Region and shares launch
        permissions with the target organization and account IDs.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'eb-cis-al2023-arm-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: >-
              CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI for Elastic
              Beanstalk.
            TargetAccountIds: !Ref TargetAccountIds
            AmiTags:
              Project: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
              Environment: Shared
              ManagedBy: CloudFormation
              BuildType: CIS-L1-ARM64
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationId}:organization/*'
      Tags:
        Project: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM64
        Environment: Shared
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        BuildType: CIS-L1-ARM64

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image pipeline - daily build with image tests and scanning enabled
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderPipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline'
      Description: >-
        Daily build of the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 Elastic
        Beanstalk image.
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref HardenedImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
