AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication.
Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateway stage.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool App Client.
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
      Description: Placeholder handler for the serverless Maths MCP server.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "status": "ok",
                      "service": "maths-mcp",
                      "message": "Placeholder handler. MCP logic to be implemented."
                  })
              }
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      Description: Regional REST API for the serverless Maths MCP server.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  LambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - RootGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment for the Maths MCP API.
  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      Description: Stage for the Maths MCP API.
Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL for the Maths MCP API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: Full URL of the protected MCP POST endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  MathsMcpFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Maths MCP Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpFunction

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  RAPIDS AI development environment on Amazon SageMaker. Creates an IAM execution
  role for SageMaker, a lifecycle configuration that provisions a pinned RAPIDS AI
  conda environment and registers a Jupyter kernel on notebook create and start,
  and an ml.t3.medium notebook instance named "rapidsai" with 50 GB of storage that
  clones the RAPIDS notebooks repository by default.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - ProjectName
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Environment Name
      ProjectName:
        default: Project Name

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for tagging resources.
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: RAPIDS
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$'
    Description: Project name used for tagging resources.

Resources:
  RAPIDSSageMakerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'sagemaker-rapidsai-${Environment}'
      Description: Execution role for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'sagemaker-rapidsai-${Environment}'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RAPIDSLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: !Sub 'rapidsai-lifecycle-${Environment}'
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -euxo pipefail

            exec > >(tee -a /var/log/rapidsai-lifecycle.log) 2>&1

            CONDA_DIR="/home/ec2-user/miniconda3"
            CONDA_BIN="${CONDA_DIR}/bin/conda"
            RAPIDS_ENV="rapids"
            RAPIDS_VERSION="24.10"
            PYTHON_VERSION="3.10"

            echo "=== RAPIDS AI lifecycle (OnCreate) started: $(date -u) ==="

            if [ ! -x "${CONDA_BIN}" ]; then
              echo "Miniconda not found. Installing Miniconda..."
              curl -fsSL -o /tmp/miniconda.sh https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh
              bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p "${CONDA_DIR}"
              rm -f /tmp/miniconda.sh
            else
              echo "Miniconda already present at ${CONDA_DIR}"
            fi

            if [ ! -f "${CONDA_DIR}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: conda.sh not found; Miniconda installation is incomplete." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            source "${CONDA_DIR}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"

            if "${CONDA_BIN}" env list | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "${RAPIDS_ENV}"; then
              echo "Updating existing conda environment ${RAPIDS_ENV} (pinned RAPIDS ${RAPIDS_VERSION})..."
              "${CONDA_BIN}" install -y -n "${RAPIDS_ENV}" \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                rapids="${RAPIDS_VERSION}" \
                python="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
                cuda-version=12.2 \
                ipykernel
            else
              echo "Creating conda environment ${RAPIDS_ENV} (pinned RAPIDS ${RAPIDS_VERSION})..."
              "${CONDA_BIN}" create -y -n "${RAPIDS_ENV}" \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                rapids="${RAPIDS_VERSION}" \
                python="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
                cuda-version=12.2 \
                ipykernel
            fi

            echo "Registering Jupyter kernel for ${RAPIDS_ENV}..."
            su - ec2-user -c "\"${CONDA_BIN}\" run -n ${RAPIDS_ENV} python -m ipykernel install --user --name ${RAPIDS_ENV} --display-name 'RAPIDS AI'"

            echo "Kernel list:"
            su - ec2-user -c "\"${CONDA_BIN}\" run -n ${RAPIDS_ENV} jupyter kernelspec list"

            echo "=== RAPIDS AI lifecycle (OnCreate) completed: $(date -u) ==="
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -euxo pipefail

            exec > >(tee -a /var/log/rapidsai-lifecycle.log) 2>&1

            CONDA_DIR="/home/ec2-user/miniconda3"
            CONDA_BIN="${CONDA_DIR}/bin/conda"
            RAPIDS_ENV="rapids"
            RAPIDS_VERSION="24.10"
            PYTHON_VERSION="3.10"

            echo "=== RAPIDS AI lifecycle (OnStart) started: $(date -u) ==="

            if [ ! -x "${CONDA_BIN}" ]; then
              echo "Miniconda not found. Installing Miniconda..."
              curl -fsSL -o /tmp/miniconda.sh https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh
              bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p "${CONDA_DIR}"
              rm -f /tmp/miniconda.sh
            else
              echo "Miniconda already present at ${CONDA_DIR}"
            fi

            if [ ! -f "${CONDA_DIR}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: conda.sh not found; Miniconda installation is incomplete." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            source "${CONDA_DIR}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"

            if "${CONDA_BIN}" env list | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "${RAPIDS_ENV}"; then
              echo "Environment ${RAPIDS_ENV} present. Verifying pinned RAPIDS ${RAPIDS_VERSION} packages..."
              "${CONDA_BIN}" install -y -n "${RAPIDS_ENV}" \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                rapids="${RAPIDS_VERSION}" \
                python="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
                cuda-version=12.2 \
                ipykernel
            else
              echo "Environment ${RAPIDS_ENV} missing. Creating it..."
              "${CONDA_BIN}" create -y -n "${RAPIDS_ENV}" \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                rapids="${RAPIDS_VERSION}" \
                python="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
                cuda-version=12.2 \
                ipykernel
            fi

            if su - ec2-user -c "\"${CONDA_BIN}\" run -n ${RAPIDS_ENV} jupyter kernelspec list" | grep -q "${RAPIDS_ENV}"; then
              echo "Jupyter kernel ${RAPIDS_ENV} already registered."
            else
              echo "Registering Jupyter kernel for ${RAPIDS_ENV}..."
            fi

            su - ec2-user -c "\"${CONDA_BIN}\" run -n ${RAPIDS_ENV} python -m ipykernel install --user --name ${RAPIDS_ENV} --display-name 'RAPIDS AI'"

            echo "Kernel list:"
            su - ec2-user -c "\"${CONDA_BIN}\" run -n ${RAPIDS_ENV} jupyter kernelspec list"

            echo "=== RAPIDS AI lifecycle (OnStart) completed: $(date -u) ==="

  RAPIDSNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RAPIDSSageMakerRole.Arn
      LifecycleConfigName: !Ref RAPIDSLifecycleConfig
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      RootAccess: Disabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance.
    Value: !GetAtt RAPIDSNotebookInstance.NotebookInstanceName
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance.
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSNotebookInstance
  SageMakerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role used by the SageMaker notebook instance.
    Value: !GetAtt RAPIDSSageMakerRole.Arn
  LifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI notebook instance lifecycle configuration.
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSLifecycleConfig

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice that registers itself with a private AWS Cloud Map
  namespace for DNS (SRV) service discovery. The stack builds its own VPC (public subnet plus
  two private subnets across two Availability Zones, internet gateway, NAT gateway), an ECS
  cluster, a container security group, a task execution role, a least-privilege task role (or an
  optional caller-supplied one), a CloudWatch log group, a Cloud Map private DNS namespace and
  service, and Application Auto Scaling with step scaling driven by two CloudWatch CPU alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Name of the environment, used in resource naming and in the private DNS namespace.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: web
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Name of the microservice, used in resource naming and in the discoverable SRV DNS name.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Container image for the microservice (defaults to the public nginx image).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: TCP port the container listens on.

  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues:
      - 256
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
      - 4096
    Description: Number of CPU units reserved for the Fargate task.

  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 512
    MaxValue: 30720
    Description: Amount of memory (MiB) reserved for the Fargate task.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of running tasks for the ECS service.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/16$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a /16 netmask.
    Description: CIDR block (/16) for the VPC that hosts the service.

  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|arn:aws:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be empty or a valid IAM role ARN of the form
      arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:role/<role-name>.
    Description: >-
      Optional pre-existing IAM role ARN that the containers can assume to access other AWS
      resources. Leave empty to use the least-privilege task role created by this template.

Conditions:
  UseCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:

  ##### Networking ###########################################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Join:
          - '.'
          -
            - Fn::Select:
                - 0
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - Fn::Select:
                - 1
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - '0'
            - '0/24'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Join:
          - '.'
          -
            - Fn::Select:
                - 0
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - Fn::Select:
                - 1
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - '1'
            - '0/24'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Join:
          - '.'
          -
            - Fn::Select:
                - 0
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - Fn::Select:
                - 1
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '.'
                    - !Ref VpcCidr
            - '2'
            - '0/24'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-natgw'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Allow containers of ${ServiceName} to communicate within the VPC CIDR range'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: !Sub 'Container port ${ContainerPort} reachable from within the VPC'
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow container port traffic to other services within the VPC
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow DNS resolution within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg'

  ##### Logging ##############################################################################

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ##### IAM ##################################################################################

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role used by the ECS agent to pull images and write container logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsTaskExecutionLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowContainerLogWrites
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
      Description: Least-privilege role assumed by the application containers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApplicationLogAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowApplicationLogWrites
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-autoscaling-role'
      Description: Role that Application Auto Scaling assumes to scale the ECS service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsServiceStepScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEcsServiceScaling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - application-autoscaling:RegisterScalableTarget
                  - application-autoscaling:DeregisterScalableTarget
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalableTargets
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingPolicies
                  - application-autoscaling:PutScalingPolicy
                  - application-autoscaling:DeleteScalingPolicy
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageScalingAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-autoscaling-role'

  ##### ECS cluster, task definition and service #############################################

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - UseCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task'

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for services running in the ${EnvironmentName} environment'
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Cloud Map service for the ${ServiceName} microservice'
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'

  ##### Application Auto Scaling #############################################################

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService.Name}'
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 5

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 300
        MinAdjustmentMagnitude: 1
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ##### CloudWatch alarms ####################################################################

  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 70
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 20
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the service.
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster hosting the service.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name

  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the service containers.
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the private Cloud Map namespace.
    Value: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the private Cloud Map namespace.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryNamespace.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service used as the ECS service registry.
    Value: !Ref DiscoveryService

  ServiceDiscoverySrvName:
    Description: Private DNS name of the discoverable SRV record for this service.
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with an
  OCI primary region. Creates a VPC, internet gateway, private subnet, route table,
  a transit gateway with VPC attachment plus a static OCI route, a restricted security
  group, an optional static-routing VPN connection to OCI, and KMS-encrypted VPC flow
  logs delivered to a CloudWatch Logs log group with 30-day retention.

Parameters:

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(3[0-2]|[12]?[0-9]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.94.0.0/16).
    Description: CIDR block for the AWS backbone VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.10.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(3[0-2]|[12]?[0-9]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.94.10.0/24).
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet created in the first available Availability Zone.

  InternalHttpsSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(3[0-2]|[12]?[0-9]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.0.0/8).
    Description: Internal / on-premises CIDR range allowed to reach the backbone over HTTPS (TCP 443).

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.95.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(3[0-2]|[12]?[0-9]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.95.0.0/16).
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR range used for HTTPS egress and for the static transit gateway route.

  OciTunnelEndpointIp:
    Type: String
    Default: "203.0.113.10"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (for example 203.0.113.10).
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI VPN tunnel endpoint used as the customer gateway address.

  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: BGP ASN of the OCI customer gateway used by the static-only VPN tunnel.

  EnableVpnConnection:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Set to "true" to create the OCI customer gateway and the static-routing VPN connection.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "dev"
    AllowedValues:
      - "dev"
      - "test"
      - "stage"
      - "prod"
    Description: Environment name applied to every taggable resource.

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: "oci-hybrid-backbone"
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
    Description: Project name applied to every taggable resource.

Conditions:

  CreateVpnConnection: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableVpnConnection
    - "true"

Resources:

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backbone-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backbone-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BackboneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS inbound only from the internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound only to the OCI backbone CIDR.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalHttpsSourceCidr
          Description: HTTPS from internal / on-premises networks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to the OCI backbone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backbone-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit gateway for AWS to OCI hybrid interconnect demonstrations.
      AmazonSideAsn: 64513
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-transit-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt VPC flow logs for the AWS to OCI hybrid backbone.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Enabled: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-role"
      Description: Least privilege role that lets VPC Flow Logs publish encrypted flow logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPublish
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Sid: UseFlowLogsCustomerManagedKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OciTunnelEndpointIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-customer-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-connection"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciVpnAttachmentLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-attachment-lookup-role"
      Description: Execution role for the lookup function that resolves the transit gateway attachment of the OCI VPN connection.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveOciVpnTransitGatewayAttachment
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeVpnTransitGatewayAttachments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeVpnConnections
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-attachment-lookup:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-attachment-lookup-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciVpnAttachmentLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-attachment-lookup"
      Description: Resolves the transit gateway attachment ID created for the OCI VPN connection.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt OciVpnAttachmentLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3


          def _send(event, context, status, reason, physical_id, data):
              body = json.dumps(
                  {
                      "Status": status,
                      "Reason": reason,
                      "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                      "StackId": event["StackId"],
                      "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                      "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                      "Data": data,
                  }
              ).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  headers={"content-type": "", "content-length": str(len(body))},
                  method="PUT",
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(request)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      _send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          "SUCCESS",
                          "Delete requested",
                          event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "oci-vpn-attachment-lookup"),
                          {},
                      )
                      return

                  vpn_connection_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["VpnConnectionId"]
                  ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
                  attachment_id = None
                  for _ in range(60):
                      response = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(
                          Filters=[
                              {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpn_connection_id]},
                              {"Name": "resource-type", "Values": ["vpn"]},
                          ]
                      )
                      attachments = response.get("TransitGatewayAttachments", [])
                      if attachments:
                          attachment_id = attachments[0]["TransitGatewayAttachmentId"]
                          break
                      time.sleep(5)

                  if attachment_id is None:
                      _send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          "FAILED",
                          "No transit gateway attachment found for VPN connection "
                          + vpn_connection_id,
                          vpn_connection_id,
                          {},
                      )
                      return

                  _send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "SUCCESS",
                      "Resolved transit gateway attachment " + attachment_id,
                      attachment_id,
                      {"AttachmentId": attachment_id},
                  )
              except Exception as error:
                  _send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "FAILED",
                      str(error),
                      "oci-vpn-attachment-lookup",
                      {},
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn-attachment-lookup"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciVpnAttachmentLookup:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt OciVpnAttachmentLookupFunction.Arn
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection

  OciBackboneRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVpnConnection
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref OciVpnAttachmentLookup

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway route table holding the OCI static route.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the KMS encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group receiving VPC flow logs.

  VpnConnectionId:

  OciVpnTransitGatewayAttachmentId:

    Description: ID of the transit gateway attachment created for the OCI VPN connection.
    Value: !Ref OciVpnAttachmentLookup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  DynamoDB table (single "USER_ID" hash key, on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery)
  plus a comprehensive set of CloudWatch alarms for table, account-level, and replication
  health monitoring. All resources required by the alarms (the table and the encrypted
  SNS notification topic, together with the KMS key that protects it) are created in this
  template; no external infrastructure, hardcoded IDs, or ARNs are referenced.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: dynamodb-health-monitor
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used for naming and tagging the resources created by this template.

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the alarm notification topic. Leave blank to skip the subscription.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref AlarmEmail
      - ''

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key used to encrypt the SNS alarm notification topic.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} SNS alarm topic encryption key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alarm-topic-key'

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-alarm-topic-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS notification topic - single alarm target for every alarm below.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ProjectName} DynamoDB Alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-alarms'

  AlarmTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table - single "USER_ID" hash key, on-demand, PITR enabled.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-table'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-table'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Table-level count / throttle / error alarms (Sum, > 1, 1 period of 60s).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB WriteThrottleEvents exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB ThrottledRequests exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB ConditionalCheckFailedRequests exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB UserErrors exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB SystemErrors exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  TransactionConflictAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-TransactionConflict'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB TransactionConflict exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: TransactionConflict
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Online index throttle events (Sum, > 10, 1 period of 60s).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OnlineIndexThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-OnlineIndexThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB OnlineIndexThrottleEvents exceeded threshold for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: OnlineIndexThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 10
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Successful request latency (Average, > 100 ms, 1 period of 60s).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SuccessfulRequestLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-SuccessfulRequestLatency'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB SuccessfulRequestLatency exceeded 100 ms for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Milliseconds
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 100
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Table-level read/write capacity utilization (Average, > 85 %, 1 period of 60s).
  # NOTE: ReadCapacityUtilization / WriteCapacityUtilization are only emitted for
  # tables using PROVISIONED capacity. Because this table uses BillingMode
  # PAY_PER_REQUEST, these alarms will remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA, which is
  # harmless given TreatMissingData: notBreaching.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TableReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-ReadCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB table ReadCapacityUtilization exceeded 85 percent for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  TableWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-WriteCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB table WriteCapacityUtilization exceeded 85 percent for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Account-level read/write capacity utilization (Average, > 85 %, 1 period of 60s).
  # NOTE: These metrics are dimensionless and cover the whole account rather than
  # only the table created by this template, therefore no Dimensions are specified.
  # They are also only emitted when provisioned capacity is in use, so on a
  # PAY_PER_REQUEST table they stay in INSUFFICIENT_DATA (harmless given
  # TreatMissingData: notBreaching).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-account-ReadCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: Account-level DynamoDB ReadCapacityUtilization exceeded 85 percent'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  AccountWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-account-WriteCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: Account-level DynamoDB WriteCapacityUtilization exceeded 85 percent'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Replication alarms (5 evaluation periods, 3 datapoints to alarm).
  # NOTE: PendingReplicationCount and ReplicationLatency are only emitted when the
  # table is a DynamoDB global table with at least one replica. This table is not
  # configured with GlobalTableVersion/Replicas (no replica region is hardcoded
  # here), so these alarms stay in INSUFFICIENT_DATA, which is harmless given
  # TreatMissingData: notBreaching.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-PendingReplicationCount'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB PendingReplicationCount exceeded 100 for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 100
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dynamodb-ReplicationLatency'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName}: DynamoDB ReplicationLatency exceeded 10 ms for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReplicationLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Milliseconds
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 10
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table created by this template.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table created by this template.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic used as the alarm notification target.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AlarmTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the alarm notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn
