AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication stack - provisions Cognito user pools, app clients, identity pools and scoped IAM roles for the PiBot web application and for IoT trusted user provisioning.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix applied to all PiBot Cognito user pools, identity pools, app clients and IAM roles.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # Web application Cognito authentication setup
  ############################################################################

  PibotWebUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true

  PibotWebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref PibotWebUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000/logout
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  PibotWebIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}_web_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PibotWebUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PibotWebUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  PibotWebAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-authenticated-role'
      Description: Authenticated role for the PiBot web application identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PibotWebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSIoTDataAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonKinesisVideoStreamsFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonRekognitionReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-authenticated-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityBootstrap
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${PibotWebIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PibotWebUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-unauthenticated-role'
      Description: Guest (unauthenticated) role for the PiBot web application identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PibotWebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-guest-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityBootstrap
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${PibotWebIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoReadAndIngest
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesisvideo:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Sid: RekognitionReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'

  PibotWebIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PibotWebIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PibotWebAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt PibotWebUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  ############################################################################
  # IoT trusted user provisioning Cognito authentication setup
  ############################################################################

  PibotProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true

  PibotProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref PibotProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  PibotProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}_provisioning_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PibotProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PibotProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  PibotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-authenticated-role'
      Description: Authenticated role granting IoT trusted user provisioning actions for the PiBot provisioning identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PibotProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-trusted-user-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TrustedUserLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateUser
                  - iot:DescribeUser
                  - iot:UpdateUser
                  - iot:DeleteUser
                  - iot:ListUsers
                  - iot:ListUserGroups
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user/*'
              - Sid: TrustedUserPolicyManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:DetachPolicy
                  - iot:ListAttachedPolicies
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:policy/*'

  PibotProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-unauthenticated-role'
      Description: Unauthenticated bootstrap role for the PiBot provisioning identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PibotProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-guest-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityBootstrap
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${PibotProvisioningIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PibotProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PibotProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PibotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt PibotProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  PibotWebIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the PiBot web application Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotWebIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotWebIdentityPoolId'

  PibotWebUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the PiBot web application Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotWebUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotWebUserPoolId'

  PibotWebUserPoolClientId:
    Description: App client ID for the PiBot web application Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotWebUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotWebUserPoolClientId'

  PibotProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotProvisioningIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotProvisioningIdentityPoolId'

  PibotProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotProvisioningUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotProvisioningUserPoolId'

  PibotProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: App client ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning Cognito authentication setup.
    Value: !Ref PibotProvisioningUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PibotProvisioningUserPoolClientId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP protocol) with a Lambda-backed MCP
  gateway target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools (invoke_endpoint and
  get_results). The gateway is protected by a custom JWT authorizer backed by a Cognito
  user pool created within this template, and it forwards MCP tool calls to a prediction
  Lambda function also created within this template. This is a self-contained,
  greenfield deployment: every dependency (the prediction Lambda, its execution role,
  the Cognito user pool and app client) is defined here, so no pre-existing resources,
  SSM parameters, VPCs, subnets, or external stacks are required. The gateway service
  role ARN is published to SSM Parameter Store for downstream consumption.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Project name driving resource naming, tag values, and SSM parameter path prefixes.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description applied verbatim to the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: >-
      Optional gateway name. Leave blank to auto-generate '<ProjectName>-mcp-gateway'.

Conditions:
  HasGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  PredictionFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the protein variant effect prediction Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-lambda-logs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: prediction-lambda

  PredictionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-prediction'
      Description: Backend Lambda that scores protein variant effect predictions.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PredictionFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "prediction service ready"})
              }

  GatewayServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: >-
        Service role assumed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the
        protein variant effect prediction Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreGatewayAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-invoke-prediction-lambda'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePredictionLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: bedrock-agentcore-gateway

  GatewayServiceRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayServiceRole.Arn
      Tags:
        ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: bedrock-agentcore-gateway

  AuthUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-auth'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true

  AuthUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AuthUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: MCP
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayServiceRole.Arn
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${AuthUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref AuthUserPoolClient
      Tags:
        ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: bedrock-agentcore-gateway

  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-protein-variant-target'
      Description: >-
        MCP target exposing the protein variant effect prediction tools backed by the
        prediction Lambda function.
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref Gateway
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >-
                    Submit a protein sequence, optionally with variant specifications, for
                    variant effect prediction and return a job identifier for later polling.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      sequence:
                        type: string
                        description: Amino-acid sequence of the reference protein.
                      variants:
                        type: array
                        description: List of variant strings (for example 'A123V') to score.
                        items:
                          type: string
                      model:
                        type: string
                        description: Optional identifier of the scoring model to use.
                    required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >-
                    Check the completion status of a previously submitted prediction job
                    and return its results once the job has finished.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      job_id:
                        type: string
                        description: Job identifier returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !Ref Gateway

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn

  GatewayEndpointUrl:
    Description: Endpoint URL that MCP clients use to reach the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayUrl

  GatewayServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayServiceRole.Arn

  GatewayServiceRoleArnSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter that stores the gateway service role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayServiceRoleArnParameter

  PredictionFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the prediction Lambda function backing the MCP target.
    Value: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn

  CognitoClientId:
    Description: App client ID used by the gateway custom JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref AuthUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Audit events SQS queue encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (rotation enabled),
  with an optional dead letter queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for
  message age and DLQ activity, and an encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications.
  All resources are self-contained and greenfield-safe.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment. Drives queue sizing and conditional resource creation.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the alarm topic. Leave empty to skip subscription.
    Default: ''

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      AgeAlarmThresholdSeconds: 3600
      AgeAlarmPeriodSeconds: 300
      DlqMessageThreshold: 1
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      AgeAlarmThresholdSeconds: 1800
      AgeAlarmPeriodSeconds: 300
      DlqMessageThreshold: 1
      MaxReceiveCount: 10
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      AgeAlarmThresholdSeconds: 900
      AgeAlarmPeriodSeconds: 300
      DlqMessageThreshold: 1
      MaxReceiveCount: 10

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']

Resources:
  AuditKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${AWS::StackName} audit queue and alarm topic encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-kms-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  AuditKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-audit-sqs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds]
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  AuditEventsDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqMessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds]
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  AuditEventsQueueAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-old-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Oldest message on ${AWS::StackName} audit events queue exceeds the ${Environment} age threshold.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AgeAlarmPeriodSeconds]
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AgeAlarmThresholdSeconds]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditEventsDlqAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-activity-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Messages have arrived on the ${AWS::StackName} audit events dead letter queue.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AgeAlarmPeriodSeconds]
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqMessageThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev environments only).
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsDlq

  AuditEventsDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev environments only).
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving CloudWatch alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for queue and topic encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn

  AuditKmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key used for queue and topic encryption.
    Value: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-audit-sqs'

      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: ApiDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for APIDataTable
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Function 1 - fetch current price from CoinGecko over HTTP
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: fetchTickerPrice
      Description: Fetch current USD price for a ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker.toLowerCase())
        #set($responseBody = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
        #set($price = $responseBody.get($ticker).get("usd"))
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": $ticker,
          "price": $price,
          "timestamp": $util.time.nowISO8601()
        })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Function 2 - persist historical price record into DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: storeTickerPrice
      Description: Persist the fetched ticker price into APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt ApiDataTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline resolver for Query.ticker -> fetch, then store
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Function 3 - query historical price records for a ticker
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetPriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: getPriceHistory
      Description: Query APIDataTable for ticker history in descending order
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt ApiDataTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :ticker",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.nextToken, null))
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.result.items, []),
          "nextToken": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.result.nextToken, null)
        })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver for TickerInfo.priceHistory
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetPriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  optional live-to-VOD archive origination control, optional VOD packaging
  (HLS/DASH) using in-template S3 buckets, an in-template customer managed KMS
  key for S3 encryption, and a least-privilege MediaPackage IAM role. All
  dependencies are created within this template for a greenfield account.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,19}$'
    ConstraintDescription: '1-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting with a letter or number.'
    Description: Lowercase logical name prefix used for naming MediaPackage and IAM resources.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment applied as a tag to every taggable resource.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Controls which optional VOD packaging configurations are created (live endpoints are always created).

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Manifest name used by origin endpoints and VOD packaging configurations.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: Startover window duration in seconds for the origin endpoints.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive content. Leave empty to use a generated name.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for VOD source content. Leave empty to use a generated name.

  CustomTags:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tags as Key=Value,Key2=Value2 entries.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  EnableVod: !And
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
  CreateHlsVod: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDashVod: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  HlsVodEnabled: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateHlsVod
  DashVodEnabled: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateDashVod
  HasCustomTags: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref CustomTags], '']]

Resources:

  MediaPackageKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for MediaPackage live-to-VOD and VOD source S3 bucket encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-kms-key'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  MediaPackageKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MediaPackageKmsKey

  Channel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage live channel for ${Environment}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${Environment}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref Channel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${Environment}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - !Ref ArchiveBucket
        - !Sub '${NamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-archive'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasVodSourceBucket
        - !Ref VodSourceBucket
        - !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-source'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLSRequests
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalType': 'Anonymous'

  VodSourceS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLSRequests
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalType': 'Anonymous'

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      Description: Role assumed by AWS Elemental MediaPackage for VOD and live-to-VOD S3 access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-vod-s3-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: VodSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: VodSourceList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
              - Sid: ArchiveWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: ArchiveList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
              - Sid: S3KmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-group'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: HlsVodEnabled
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-hls'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-hls'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: DashVodEnabled
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-dash'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-dash'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodAsset:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-asset'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      SourceArn: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
      SourceRoleArn: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-asset'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTags
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Ref CustomTags]]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage channel Id.
    Value: !Ref Channel

  ChannelArn:
    Description: MediaPackage channel ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt Channel.Arn

  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Description: HLS origin endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url

  DashEndpointUrl:
    Description: DASH origin endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url

  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Description: MediaPackage VOD packaging group Id.
    Condition: EnableVod
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup

  VodAssetId:
    Description: MediaPackage VOD asset Id.
    Condition: EnableVod
    Value: !Ref VodAsset

  MediaPackageVodRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by MediaPackage for VOD/live-to-VOD.
    Condition: EnableVod
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn

  ArchiveBucketName:
    Description: Name of the live-to-VOD archive S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref ArchiveS3Bucket

  ArchiveBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the live-to-VOD archive S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn

  VodSourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the VOD source S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref VodSourceS3Bucket

  VodSourceBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the VOD source S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used for S3 bucket encryption.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM foundation for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA). Creates the control plane,
  controllers, controllers-EKS and nodes IAM roles, their EC2 instance profiles,
  and the AWS-managed and custom managed policies required to manage EC2-based
  and EKS-based Kubernetes cluster lifecycle. Every resource is defined in this
  template; no external VPCs, subnets, key pairs, secrets, parameters, exports
  or pre-existing roles are referenced.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy - CAPA control plane (EC2 / ELB / Auto Scaling / KMS)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-control-plane
      Description: Broad EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling and KMS permissions for the CAPA EC2-based control plane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Management
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'ec2:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'autoscaling:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy - CAPA controllers (EC2 + EKS workloads)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers
      Description: Networking, load balancing, auto scaling and instance lifecycle permissions for CAPA controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: VPCNetworkingReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: VPCNetworkingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EC2InstanceLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:RebootInstances
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile
              - ec2:DisassociateIamInstanceProfile
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EC2TagManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LaunchTemplateManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:launch-template/*'
          - Sid: LoadBalancingReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LoadBalancingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener-rule/*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:autoscaling:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:autoScalingGroup:*:autoScalingGroupName/*'
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntryManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
          - Sid: CreateElasticLoadBalancingServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: PassClusterRolesToServices
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${CAPANodesRole}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${CAPAEKSControlPlaneRole}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy - CAPA controllers / EKS scope
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers-eks
      Description: EKS cluster and nodegroup lifecycle, SSM lookup, IAM inspection and KMS permissions for CAPA controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusterLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListUpdates
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
          - Sid: EKSNodegroupLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:nodegroup/*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterLookup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/*'
          - Sid: IAMReadOnlyInspection
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSForClusterEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ListAliases
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:RequestAlias: 'alias/cluster-api-provider-aws*'
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/cluster-api-provider-aws*'
          - Sid: CreateEKSServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy - CAPA nodes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPANodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-nodes
      Description: EC2 read, ECR pull, SSM lookup, S3 bootstrap artifact read and node bootstrap secret access for CAPA nodes
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2ReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRAuthorization
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterLookup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/*'
          - Sid: S3BootstrapArtifacts
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::capa-bootstrap-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::capa-bootstrap-*/*'
          - Sid: NodeBootstrapSecretAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane
      Description: CAPA EC2-based control plane role assumed by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: ClusterAPIProviderAWS

  CAPAControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumed by EC2 instances and by EKS Pod Identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AndEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersPolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: ClusterAPIProviderAWS

  CAPANodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes
      Description: CAPA node role assumed by EC2 worker nodes for both EC2-based and EKS-based clusters
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Ref CAPANodesPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: ClusterAPIProviderAWS

  CAPAEKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-control-plane
      Description: Amazon EKS cluster control plane role assumed by the EKS service
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: ClusterAPIProviderAWS

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-control-plane
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlaneRole

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-controllers
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

  CAPANodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-nodes
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPANodesRole

Outputs:

  CAPAControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA EC2-based control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControlPlaneRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControlPlaneRoleArn'

  CAPAControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControllersRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControllersRoleArn'

  CAPANodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt CAPANodesRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPANodesRoleArn'

  CAPAEKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon EKS cluster control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAEKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAEKSControlPlaneRoleArn'

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the CAPA control plane instance profile
    Value: !Ref CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfileName'

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn'

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the CAPA controllers instance profile
    Value: !Ref CAPAControllersInstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControllersInstanceProfileName'

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControllersInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPAControllersInstanceProfileArn'

  CAPANodesInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the CAPA nodes instance profile
    Value: !Ref CAPANodesInstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPANodesInstanceProfileName'

  CAPANodesInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt CAPANodesInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CAPANodesInstanceProfileArn'
