final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for
  x86_64 and arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, then
  distributes the AMIs publicly and to an AWS Organization.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version such as 1.0.0
    Description: Semantic version applied to the Image Builder components, recipes and pipelines.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16000
    Description: Root EBS volume size (GiB) for the built AMIs.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID such as o-abcdef0123
    Description: AWS Organizations ID that the produced AMIs are shared with.

  BuildInstanceTypeX86:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.large
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\.[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: EC2 instance type used for x86_64 image builds.

  BuildInstanceTypeArm64:
    Type: String
    Default: m6g.large
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\.[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: EC2 instance type used for arm64 image builds.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key for S3 build log encryption
  ###########################################################################
  LoggingBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt EC2 Image Builder build logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  LoggingBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LoggingBucketKey

  ###########################################################################
  # Logging bucket for Image Builder build logs
  ###########################################################################
  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LoggingBucketKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireImageBuilderLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role and instance profile assumed by the Image Builder build instance
  ###########################################################################
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLoggingAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogsToStackBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: UseLoggingBucketKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role used by the Image Builder service
  ###########################################################################
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-service-role'
      Description: Service role that EC2 Image Builder assumes to orchestrate builds and distributions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderScopedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccessStackBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: UseLoggingBucketKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucketKey.Arn
              - Sid: PassBuildInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BuildInstanceRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Image Builder components
  ###########################################################################
  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-install-software'
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, and enables passwordless sudo for ssm-user.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftware
        description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, and enables passwordless sudo for ssm-user.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateOperatingSystem
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf upgrade -y --refresh
              - name: InstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker curl python3 python3-pip
              - name: EnableDockerService
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - curl -sSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 0755 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - docker compose version
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - id -u ssm-user >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - usermod -aG docker ssm-user
                    - printf 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  TestSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-software'
      Description: Verifies Docker Compose availability and Python imports for synapseclient, pandas and pysftp.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: TestSoftware
        description: Verifies Docker Compose availability and Python imports for synapseclient, pandas and pysftp.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker --version
                    - docker compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('python imports ok')"

  ###########################################################################
  # Image recipes (x86_64 and arm64)
  ###########################################################################
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 image with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 image with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  ###########################################################################
  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared build infrastructure for the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 and arm64 recipes.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceTypeX86
        - !Ref BuildInstanceTypeArm64
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LoggingBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/imagebuilder'
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Distribution configuration (public launch permissions + org sharing)
  ###########################################################################
  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: Distributes the built AMIs publicly and shares them with an AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 image built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023'
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
              ImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Image pipelines
  ###########################################################################
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86_64'
      Description: Builds and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64'
      Description: Builds and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref X86ImagePipeline

  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImagePipeline

  X86ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 Amazon Linux 2023 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref X86ImageRecipe

  Arm64ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Amazon Linux 2023 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Image Builder distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Image Builder infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration

  BuildInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile used by Image Builder build instances.
    Value: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile

  BuildLoggingBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores Image Builder build logs.
    Value: !Ref LoggingBucket

  LoggingBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt build logs.
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingBucketKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication - Amazon Cognito user pool (PLUS tier with
  enforced advanced security), public SPA client, separate admin auth client, M2M OAuth2 client
  with resource server, staff role groups, and a hosted UI domain. All dependencies (email sender,
  domain, scopes) are contained in this stack; Cognito's built-in email sender is used, so a
  production SES identity may be required to lift daily email sending limits.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names, the user pool domain, and export names.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User pool - guests and staff, email as the sign-in identifier.
  # PLUS tier is required for enforced advanced security. Retain policies keep
  # guest and staff identities if the stack is deleted or replaced.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: "custom:guest_id"
          AttributeDataType: String
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: "custom:property_id"
          AttributeDataType: String
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: "custom:region"
          AttributeDataType: String
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Mutable: true
          Required: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public SPA client - SRP only, no secret, no OAuth2 / M2M scopes.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SpaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Admin client - server-side test harnesses and simulators.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource server defining the API scopes used by the M2M client.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: anycompany-hotel-api
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Machine-to-machine OAuth2 client - client_credentials flow with a secret.
  # SRP and admin-user-password flows are intentionally not enabled.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  M2MUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ApiResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${ApiResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${ApiResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Staff role groups.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel system administrators
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel property managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel regional managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel revenue managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel front desk staff
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel housekeeping staff
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI / OAuth2 domain. Environment and account ID make the name unique
  # and give access to the OAuth2 token endpoint.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID for AnyCompany Hotel guests and staff.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-user-pool-id"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN for AnyCompany Hotel guests and staff.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-user-pool-arn"

  SpaUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Public SPA client ID using SRP authentication.
    Value: !Ref SpaUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-spa-client-id"

  AdminUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Admin client ID for server-side test harnesses and simulators.
    Value: !Ref AdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-admin-client-id"

  M2MUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine OAuth2 client ID using client_credentials.
    Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-m2m-client-id"

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the AnyCompany Hotel API resource server.
    Value: !Ref ApiResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-resource-server-identifier"

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain for the AnyCompany Hotel user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-user-pool-domain"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights - Amazon Cognito authentication stack (prod environment).
  Creates a self-contained Cognito user pool with a custom 'custom:last_login' attribute,
  a Python 3.12 post-authentication Lambda trigger that records the last login timestamp,
  three user groups (Admin, RegularUser, PowerUser), an application client with a 24-hour
  session, and a Cognito hosted UI domain prefix. Optional SAML SSO federation is driven by
  the SSOProviderName and SSOLoginUrl parameters, which default to empty values and
  therefore keep SSO disabled unless explicitly configured.
  GREENFIELD LIMITATION: no federated identity provider metadata, no IdP trust relationship,
  no ACM certificate and no registered DNS domain exist in this account. The SSO provider
  path below is therefore only syntactically deployable; real federation must be completed
  after deployment by supplying SSOProviderName and SSOLoginUrl.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be one of dev, staging or prod (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only).
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment name used to build resource names and tags for the
      Hospitality Insights Cognito stack.

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,31}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Leave empty (default) to disable SSO, or provide a 2-32 character federated identity
      provider name that starts with a letter.
    Description: >-
      Optional federated identity provider name for SSO. An empty value disables SSO.

  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 300
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^https://[^\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Leave empty (default) to disable SSO, or provide the https IdP login/metadata URL.
    Description: >-
      Optional federated IdP login or SAML metadata URL used when SSO is enabled.
      This is a non-secret endpoint URL only - never store credentials or client secrets here.

Conditions:
  # SSO stays disabled while SSOProviderName keeps its empty default value.
  IsSSOEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
  # The federated login/metadata URL is only used when it is actually supplied.
  IsSSOLoginUrlProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, '']]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-authentication Lambda trigger (Python 3.12, inline source - greenfield
  # accounts have no pre-existing S3 bucket to host deployment packages).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication'
      Description: Records the last login time on the Cognito user profile.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          COGNITO_IDP = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE = "custom:last_login"


          def _utc_timestamp():
              """Current UTC time in ISO 8601 format."""
              return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """Cognito post-authentication trigger: update custom:last_login."""
              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              username = event.get("userName")
              if not username:
                  username = (
                      (event.get("request") or {}).get("userAttributes", {}).get("sub")
                  )

              try:
                  COGNITO_IDP.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, "Value": _utc_timestamp()}
                      ],
                  )
                  LOGGER.info("Updated %s for user %s", LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, username)
              except Exception:
                  # Bookkeeping failures must never interrupt the sign-in flow.
                  LOGGER.exception(
                      "Failed to update %s for user %s", LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, username
                  )

              # Return the unmodified event so Cognito continues authentication.
              return event

  PostAuthenticationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights Cognito post-authentication trigger.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # This inline policy is declared as its own AWS::IAM::Policy resource (instead of
  # being embedded in the role's Policies property) on purpose: the user pool references
  # the function, which references this role, so embedding a policy that references
  # !GetAtt UserPool.Arn in the role would create a circular dependency.
  PostAuthenticationRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-post-auth-cognito-update'
      Roles:
        - !Ref PostAuthenticationRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthenticationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito user pool (stateful - retained on stack deletion/replacement)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool'
      # Email is both the sign-in identifier and the auto-verified attribute.
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: AUDIT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        # Custom attribute written by the post-authentication trigger.
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: hospitality-insights
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName
        Name: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      # 24-hour session timeout is modelled with the refresh token lifetime.
      # NOTE: AuthSessionValidity is expressed in MINUTES and is limited to 3-15, so it
      # cannot represent a 24-hour session and is intentionally not used here.
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      # Loopback defaults only - no external domains/certificates exist in this account.
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/logout
      # COGNITO is always present; the federated provider is added only when configured.
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - IsSSOEnabled
        - - !Ref SSOProviderName
          - COGNITO
        - - COGNITO

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional federated identity provider (SAML). Only created when SSOProviderName
  # is supplied; no IdP metadata is hardcoded - it comes from SSOLoginUrl.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: IsSSOEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      AttributeMapping:
        email: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !If
          - IsSSOLoginUrlProvided
          - !Ref SSOLoginUrl
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Full administrative access to Hospitality Insights.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Standard Hospitality Insights user.
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Elevated Hospitality Insights user.
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain (Cognito prefix only -> <prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com).
  # CustomDomainConfig is deliberately NOT set: a fully custom FQDN requires an ACM
  # certificate in us-east-1 plus DNS validation records, which cannot exist in a
  # greenfield account with no registered domain.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights application client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Hosted UI domain (Cognito prefix) of the Hospitality Insights user pool.
    # Ref on AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain returns the domain name; 'Domain' is not a
    # valid GetAtt attribute for this resource.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain

  HostedUiLoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login URL for the Hospitality Insights application client.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login'

  PostAuthenticationFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito post-authentication Lambda trigger.
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn

  UserGroups:
    Description: User groups created in the Hospitality Insights user pool.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AdminGroup
        - !Ref RegularUserGroup
        - !Ref PowerUserGroup

  SSOProviderName:
    Condition: IsSSOEnabled
    Description: Federated identity provider name configured for the user pool.
    Value: !Ref SSOProviderName

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment the Hospitality Insights Cognito stack was deployed for.
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions-only AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) chaos-engineering stack. It creates
  an FIS experiment template with its IAM execution role, a dedicated KMS key and alias, a
  CloudWatch Logs log group, and a stop-condition alarm, but it never runs or executes the
  experiment. The experiment blocks application network traffic from the deployment region
  to TargetRegion and pauses cross-region replication for Duration (default PT20M, 20
  minutes). Only resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true are targeted; FIS resolves them at
  experiment-run time, so no VPC, subnet, or table is created or referenced here and the
  stack deploys cleanly in an empty account. See the Metadata block for documented
  limitations.

Metadata:
  ChaosEngineering:
    ExecutionMode: Provision-only. The FIS experiment template is created but never started by this stack.
    TargetSelection: Resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true (subnets, DynamoDB global tables, transit gateways, S3 buckets) are resolved by FIS at experiment-run time.
    DocumentedLimitations:
      - No verified FIS action identifier exists for disrupting transit gateway / route table connectivity; no such action is defined.
      - No verified FIS action identifier exists for pausing S3 cross-region replication; no such action is defined.
      - Transit gateways and S3 buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true remain the stated chaos intent but are not targetable with the currently verified FIS action catalog.
      - Tagged targets are not created or referenced by this stack and must be tagged ChaosAllowed=true before the experiment is started.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region form such as us-west-2 or us-gov-west-1.
    Description: The AWS region whose application traffic is blocked by the chaos experiment.
  Duration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT\d+M$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO-8601 duration expressed in minutes, for example PT20M.
    Description: ISO-8601 duration for the cross-region replication pause (default is 20 minutes).

Resources:
  ChaosLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key dedicated to encrypting AWS FIS chaos experiment logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsDescribeKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsCryptoOperationsForThisLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/chaos-experiment'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-services
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ChaosLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/chaos-fis-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ChaosLogsKey

  ChaosLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/fis/chaos-experiment
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ChaosLogsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-services
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ChaosStopAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: chaos-fis-experiment-stop-condition
      AlarmDescription: Stop condition for the AWS FIS chaos experiment; stays in OK state when no datapoints are published.
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      MetricName: ChaosExperimentFailure
      Namespace: ChaosEngineering/FIS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-services
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FisExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: chaos-fis-experiment-execution-role
      Path: /chaos/
      Description: Execution role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator when running the chaos experiment.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'fis.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: chaos-fis-execution-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsExperimentLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt ChaosLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: Ec2TargetDiscoveryForNetworkDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBGlobalTableDiscoveryForReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb::${AWS::AccountId}:global-table/*'
              - Sid: FisExperimentIntrospection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fis:GetExperiment
                  - fis:ListTagsForResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-services
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Chaos experiment: block application network traffic from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion} and pause cross-region DynamoDB global table replication for ${Duration}; targets resolved by the ChaosAllowed=true tag.'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExecutionRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm
          Value: !GetAtt ChaosStopAlarm.Arn
      Targets:
        chaosSubnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        chaosGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      Actions:
        blockCrossRegionNetworkTraffic:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: !Sub 'Blocks application network traffic originating in ${AWS::Region} toward ${TargetRegion} for the configured duration.'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref Duration
            scope: all
          Targets:
            chaosSubnets: chaosSubnets
        pauseGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: !Sub 'Pauses cross-region replication of the tagged DynamoDB global tables for ${Duration}.'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref Duration
          Targets:
            chaosGlobalTables: chaosGlobalTables
      LogConfiguration:
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ChaosLogGroup.Arn
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
      Tags:
        Project: chaos-engineering
        Environment: shared-services
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
        PauseDuration: !Ref Duration

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: Identifier of the provisioned AWS FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref ChaosExperimentTemplate
  ExperimentTemplateArn:
    Description: ARN of the provisioned AWS FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/${ChaosExperimentTemplate}'
  FisExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that AWS FIS assumes when running this experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExecutionRole.Arn
  ChaosLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group used for experiment logging.
    Value: !Ref ChaosLogGroup
  ChaosLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group used for experiment logging.
    Value: !GetAtt ChaosLogGroup.Arn
  ChaosLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key dedicated to experiment log encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt ChaosLogsKey.Arn
  ChaosLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key dedicated to experiment log encryption.
    Value: alias/chaos-fis-logs
  ChaosStopConditionAlarmArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment with Transit Gateway, NAT gateways, VPC flow logs to CloudWatch, and interface/gateway VPC endpoints for private subnet access to AWS services.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name prefix applied to every resource Name tag, logical identifier, and export.

Resources:

  HubVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet1NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet2NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      Description: !Sub ${EnvironmentName} hub transit gateway
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-transit-gateway
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        Ipv6Support: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tgw-vpc-attachment
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  PrivateSubnet1TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet2TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
      Description: Least privilege role allowing VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Security group for ${EnvironmentName} interface VPC endpoints (HTTPS from VPC CIDR)
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the hub VPC CIDR to interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS responses within the hub VPC CIDR only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  SsmVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2messages
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssmmessages
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  LogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

  S3GatewayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-s3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-landing-zone

Outputs:

  HubVpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC identifier
    Value: !Ref HubVPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-id

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 identifier
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 identifier
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 identifier
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 identifier
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: Private route table 1 identifier
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-1-id

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: Private route table 2 identifier
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-2-id

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway identifier for spoke attachments
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-transit-gateway-id

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: Hub VPC attachment identifier on the Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-transit-gateway-attachment-id

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group identifier used by the interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-sg-id

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group name receiving VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-log-group-name
