    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second Studio subnet (must fall within VpcCidr).

Conditions:
  HasExistingDomain: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref ExistingDomainId
      - ''
  CreateNewDomain: !Not
    - !Condition HasExistingDomain
  HasExistingSecurityGroupIds: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Join ['', !Ref ExistingSecurityGroupIds]
      - ''
  HasExistingSubnetIds: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Join ['', !Ref ExistingSubnetIds]
      - ''
  HasExistingNetworkConfiguration: !And
    - !Condition HasExistingSecurityGroupIds
    - !Condition HasExistingSubnetIds

Resources:

  MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-mlops-engineer-sagemaker-role'
      Description: !Sub 'SageMaker execution role scoped to the MLOps engineer persona for ${ProjectName} ${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-mlops-engineer-sagemaker-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassExecutionRoleToSageMakerOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-mlops-engineer-sagemaker-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ManageSageMakerPipelinesAndExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageModelMonitoringSchedulesAndProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageModelsAndModelPackageGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageExperimentsTrialsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RunTrainingTransformProcessingAndTuningJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageEndpointsAndEndpointConfigurations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageOwnedStudioAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    aws:ResourceTag/sagemaker:user-profile-arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*/${UserProfileName}'
              - Sid: SageMakerReadOnlySupportAndTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteSageMakerRuntimeLogsToCloudWatch
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-route-table'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    # The internet gateway must be attached to the VPC before this route can be created.
    DependsOn: StudioVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Network access for the ${ProjectName} ${EnvironmentName} SageMaker Studio domain'
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow traffic only within the Studio VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-security-group'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StudioSecurityGroupIngressNfs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 2049
      ToPort: 2049
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Description: NFS traffic between SageMaker Studio domain resources

  StudioSecurityGroupIngressStudio:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8192
      ToPort: 8192
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Description: SageMaker Studio application traffic between domain resources

  StudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-studio-domain'
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      AuthMode: IAM
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref StudioSubnet1
        - !Ref StudioSubnet2
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !GetAtt StudioSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  MLOpsEngineerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - HasExistingDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
        - !Ref StudioDomain
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - HasExistingNetworkConfiguration
          - !Ref ExistingSecurityGroupIds
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker Studio user profile created for the MLOps engineer persona
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerUserProfile.UserProfileArn
  MLOpsEngineerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scoped SageMaker execution role used by the MLOps engineer persona
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsEngineerExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions composite CloudWatch alarms for monitoring the health of the
  cross-region failover Remittance application: "API Gateway Health", "Lambda
  Health", and "RDS Health". Each composite alarm aggregates its underlying
  metric alarms with an OR-based alarm rule, so any single triggered condition
  trips the composite. This is a monitoring-only template: it creates no VPCs,
  subnets, security groups, IAM roles, SNS topics, or data stores, and it
  defines no alarm actions or notification targets. PREREQUISITE: the monitored
  resources must already exist in this account and Region under the names
  supplied by the parameters (the Remittance API Gateway API, the
  GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance). Metric alarms created for dimension
  values that do not exist deploy successfully but remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA
  until the referenced resource exists.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: >-
      Environment name used to tag and group all alarms created by this
      template (for example dev, test, staging, or prod).

  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing Amazon API Gateway REST API to monitor. Used as the
      ApiName dimension in the AWS/ApiGateway namespace.

  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function to monitor. Used as
      the FunctionName dimension in the AWS/Lambda namespace.

  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function to monitor. Used as
      the FunctionName dimension in the AWS/Lambda namespace.

  RDSInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: >-
      Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance to monitor. Used as the
      DBInstanceIdentifier dimension in the AWS/RDS namespace.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # API Gateway metric alarms (namespace: AWS/ApiGateway)
  ##############################################################################

  ApiFourXXErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Remittance-API-4XX-Errors
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Triggers when the average 4XX error count of API Gateway API
        ${ApiName} is greater than 0 over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance

  ApiFiveXXErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:

  # Composite alarms
  # Composite alarms are defined with the dedicated AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm

  # alarm names create the correct implicit ordering.
  ##############################################################################

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite alarm that trips when any Remittance API Gateway metric alarm
        (4XX errors, 5XX errors, or latency) is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${FourXXAlarm}") OR ALARM("${FiveXXAlarm}") OR ALARM("${LatencyAlarm}")'
        - FourXXAlarm: !Ref ApiFourXXErrorsAlarm
          FiveXXAlarm: !Ref ApiFiveXXErrorsAlarm
          LatencyAlarm: !Ref ApiLatencyAlarm
      Tags:

          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application

  # per the explicit specification that the rule ORs only the Errors and
  # Duration alarms. Revisit if the invocations alarms should also feed the
  # composite.
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite alarm that trips when any referenced Remittance Lambda metric
        alarm (Errors or Duration for GetRemittances or CreateRemittance) is in
        ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrors}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrors}") OR ALARM("${GetRemittancesDuration}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDuration}")'

          GetRemittancesDuration: !Ref GetRemittancesDurationAlarm

      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${Cpu}") OR ALARM("${Connections}") OR ALARM("${Deadlocks}") OR ALARM("${Transmit}") OR ALARM("${Receive}") OR ALARM("${Queries}") OR ALARM("${DiskQueue}") OR ALARM("${ReadLatency}") OR ALARM("${WriteLatency}")'

          Receive: !Ref RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin-suite monitoring and data-extraction pipeline. Creates seven AWS Glue jobs
  (five Python shell jobs on Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9 and two Spark ETL jobs on Glue 5.0 with G.1X
  workers and two workers each), scheduled every three hours by dedicated Glue triggers, writing
  into a private S3 bucket encrypted with a customer managed KMS key. Five CloudWatch metric
  streams publish QuickSight metrics through five DirectPut Amazon Data Firehose delivery streams
  into the same bucket. A single shared IAM role is used by Glue, Firehose, CloudWatch metric
  streams and CloudFormation.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SECURITY CAVEAT: the shared runtime role below trusts cloudformation.amazonaws.com in addition
# to glue / firehose / streams.metrics.cloudwatch. Trusting CloudFormation in a *runtime* role is
# unusual: any CloudFormation stack in this account could then assume a role that can read
# QuickSight metadata and write to the monitoring bucket. It is kept here only because the
# deployment requirement asked for it - remove that principal once it is no longer required.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-suite
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
    Description: Short project name used to build the shared role name and to tag the resources created by this stack.

  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-suite-glue-scripts
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid, globally unique, lowercase S3 bucket name.
    Description: >-
      Name of the bucket that holds the Glue job scripts (etl_job_admin_suite_*.py). The scripts
      are external application content: upload them to this bucket (or override this parameter
      with the name of an existing script bucket) before running the Glue jobs. The template
      references the scripts but cannot create their contents.

  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: glue/scripts
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9!_.*''()/-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 object key prefix.
    Description: Key prefix inside the script bucket where the seven Glue job scripts live.

Resources:

  #############################################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key protecting the output bucket and the pipeline data
  #############################################################################################
  MonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight admin-suite extraction output bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSharedRoleUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-monitoring-role'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  MonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-output-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MonitoringKey

  #############################################################################################
  # Single shared IAM role
  #############################################################################################
  SharedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-monitoring-role'
      Description: Shared role for the QuickSight admin-suite monitoring pipeline (Glue, Firehose, CloudWatch metric streams).
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueCloudFormationFirehoseAndMetricStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightReadOnlyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # QuickSight list/describe APIs are not resource-scoped, so a wildcard resource is
              # required for the enumeration calls - this is not an over-broad grant.
              - Sid: EnumerateQuickSightAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListTopics
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:ListFolderMembers
                  - quicksight:ListIngestions
                  - quicksight:ListThemes
                  - quicksight:ListTemplates
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                  - quicksight:ListGroupMemberships
                  - quicksight:ListTagsForResource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboardPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSetPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSourcePermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopic
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolderPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeIngestion
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeGroup
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: GlueJobAndCatalogAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ResourceScopedGlueActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:StopTrigger
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:GetConnection
                  - glue:GetConnections
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                  - glue:GetTags
                  - glue:TagResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              # Catalog-wide discovery calls are not resource-scoped.
              - Sid: CatalogDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:ListJobs
                  - glue:ListTriggers
                  - glue:SearchTables
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: ScriptAndOutputBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadGlueScripts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/*'
              - Sid: ListAndLocateScriptBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
              - Sid: ReadWriteOutputObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: DescribeOutputBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn

        - PolicyName: OutputBucketKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseCustomerManagedKeyForOutputData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MonitoringKey.Arn

        - PolicyName: CloudWatchMetricsAndLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # cloudwatch:PutMetricData does not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: PublishAndReadMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageMetricStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:TagResource
                  - cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:metric-stream/*'
              - Sid: GlueJobLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'

        - PolicyName: FirehoseDeliveryAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteAndDescribeDeliveryStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListTagsForDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:TagDeliveryStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Sid: ListDeliveryStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: ScopedPassRoleAndRoleIntrospection
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassOnlyThisSharedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-monitoring-role'
              - Sid: ReadOwnRoleDefinition
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-monitoring-role'

  #############################################################################################
  # Private output bucket holding every extracted QuickSight dataset
  #############################################################################################
  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MonitoringKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: 'aws:kms'

  #############################################################################################
  # Five Python shell jobs (Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9) and two Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X x2)
  # NOTE: confirm the Glue-version / Python-version / worker-type combinations against the
  # current AWS Glue support matrix before deployment.
  # NOTE: ScriptLocation points at script objects in the script bucket - those .py files must be
  # uploaded before (or alongside) this stack, the template cannot create their contents.
  #############################################################################################
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset access details for the admin console.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_bucket_arn': !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${OutputBucket}/assets-access/'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: quicksight-admin-suite

  #############################################################################################
  # Five DirectPut Firehose delivery streams writing into the output bucket
  # DeliveryStreamName is set explicitly so the resource is fully specified and Ref returns it.
  #############################################################################################
  FirehoseIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ingestion'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/ingestion/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'quicksight/errors/ingestion/!{firehose:error-output-type}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        S3BackupMode: Disabled
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt MonitoringKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles and customer managed policies required by the Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for an Amazon EKS cluster. The template is
  self-contained: every dependent resource is declared in this stack and all account,
  partition and region specific values are resolved with CloudFormation intrinsic
  functions.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: >-
        CAPA control plane role, assumed by the EC2 instances that run the Kubernetes
        control plane of a workload cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2InstancesToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref NodePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws-role
          Value: control-plane

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: >-
        CAPA nodes role, assumed by the EC2 worker nodes of a workload cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2InstancesToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws-role
          Value: node

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: >-
        CAPA controllers role, assumed by the EC2 bootstrap instance and by the CAPA
        controller manager pods running in the management cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2InstancesToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          # The issuer ARN is derived from the partition, the current account and the
          # current region; only the cluster OIDC provider identifier is literal
          # because it is generated by Amazon EKS when the workload cluster is created.
          - Sid: AllowEKSWebIdentityToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/id/A1B2C3D4E5F6789012345678ABCDEF01'
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws-role
          Value: controllers

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-control-plane-role
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the Amazon EKS service to manage the control plane of the
        management and workload clusters.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSControlPlaneServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: eks-control-plane-role
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws-role
          Value: eks-control-plane

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Map Appraiser geographic ETL stack. Provisions a customer managed KMS key and
  the S3 buckets used by the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON pipeline (all encrypted with
  SSE-KMS using the CMK), the AWS Glue service IAM role (AWSGlueServiceRole
  managed policy plus inline CloudWatch Logs, scoped S3, and KMS policies), and
  an AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job that converts shapefiles into individual GeoJSON
  files.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Glue ETL Configuration
        Parameters:
          - GlueJobName
          - GlueScriptLocation
          - GlueServiceRoleName
    ParameterLabels:
      GlueJobName:
        default: Glue Job Name
      GlueScriptLocation:
        default: Glue ETL Script S3 Location
      GlueServiceRoleName:
        default: Glue Service Role Name

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job that converts shapefiles to GeoJSON.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: >
      S3 URI of the PySpark ETL script that must exist before the job is first run
      (CloudFormation cannot upload the script artifact itself).

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the AWS Glue ETL job.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: CloudFormation cannot upload the ETL script artifact. The file
#       "shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py" must be uploaded to the GlueScriptLocation
#       path (s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py) before
#       the job is run for the first time, e.g.:
#         aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
#
# NOTE (optional hardening, not enabled here): an AWS::Glue::SecurityConfiguration
#       with S3 / CloudWatch / job-bookmark encryption could be added on top of the
#       CMK created below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # --------------------------- KMS key for S3 -------------------------------

  MapAppraiserS3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the Map Appraiser S3 buckets (SSE-KMS).
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production

  MapAppraiserS3KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/map-appraiser-s3
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MapAppraiserS3KmsKey

  # ----------------------------- S3 buckets --------------------------------

  RawGisDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MapAppraiserS3KmsKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: raw-gis-input

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-glue-scripts
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MapAppraiserS3KmsKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: glue-scripts-and-temp

  KnowledgeBaseDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MapAppraiserS3KmsKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: geojson-output

  # ---------------------------- Glue IAM role ------------------------------

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: >
        Service role assumed by the Map Appraiser AWS Glue ETL job that converts
        shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files. Grants CloudWatch Logs write
        access, read-only access to the raw GIS and Glue script buckets,
        read/write access to the knowledge base output bucket, and use of the
        SSE-KMS customer managed key.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueServicePrincipal
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production

  GlueCloudWatchLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: map-appraiser-glue-cloudwatch-logs
      Roles:
        - !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: GlueCloudWatchLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:AssociateKmsKey
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'

  GlueS3ReadOnlyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: map-appraiser-glue-s3-read-only
      Roles:
        - !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadRawGisAndScriptsBuckets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RawGisDataBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RawGisDataBucket}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${GlueScriptsBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${GlueScriptsBucket}/*'

  GlueS3ReadWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: map-appraiser-glue-s3-read-write
      Roles:
        - !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${KnowledgeBaseDataBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${KnowledgeBaseDataBucket}/*'

  GlueKmsAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: map-appraiser-glue-kms-access
      Roles:
        - !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: UseS3EncryptionKey
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !GetAtt MapAppraiserS3KmsKey.Arn

  # ------------------------------ Glue ETL job ------------------------------

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: >
        AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job that converts source shapefiles into
        individual GeoJSON files in the Map Appraiser knowledge base bucket.
      Role: !GetAtt ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--TempDir': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas==0.14.1,shapely==2.0.2,pyproj==3.6.1,fiona==1.9.5'
      Tags:
        Project: map-appraiser
        Environment: production

# ------------------------------- Outputs -----------------------------------

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobName

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueRole.Arn

  S3ScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: >
      Command that uploads the ETL script artifact to the GlueScriptLocation
      path. The script must be uploaded before the Glue job is first run.
    Value: aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated, scheduled enforcement of account-level Amazon S3 Block Public Access. This stack
  creates an AWS Systems Manager Automation document (schema version 0.3) that calls the
  Amazon S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API to enable BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy,
  IgnorePublicAcls, and RestrictPublicBuckets for the local account, an IAM role for Systems
  Manager Automation, an IAM role for Amazon EventBridge, and an enabled EventBridge scheduled
  rule that starts the automation on a daily cadence.

Resources:

  SsmAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation to enable account-level S3 Block
        Public Access for the local account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccountLevelS3BlockPublicAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutAndGetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enforce-account-s3-block-public-access'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) The ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes
              when it calls the Amazon S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableAccountLevelBlockPublicAccess
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
              AccountId: '{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            isEnd: true

  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to start the account-level
        S3 Block Public Access automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountBlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartSsmAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
              - Sid: PassAutomationAssumeRoleToSystemsManager
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  DailyBlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-account-s3-block-public-access'
      Description: >-
        Starts the account-level S3 Block Public Access SSM Automation document once per day.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      State: ENABLED

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Test environment for validating Service Catalog preventive controls. Provisions a
  dedicated VPC with two subnets, a test security group, a customer managed KMS key
  with an alias, DMS replication resources (including the dms-vpc-role), ElastiCache
  subnet and cache security groups, a SageMaker execution role, and one Service Catalog
  launch role per supported product type.

Resources:

  ############################################################
  # Network
  ############################################################

  TestVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive control test resources
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################
  # KMS
  ############################################################

  TestKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Service Catalog preventive control tests
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesAndSageMakerToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleALB.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAutoScaling.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDMS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDynamoDB.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEBS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEFS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElastiCache.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElasticsearch.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleFSx.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleKinesis.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSNS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSQS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSageMaker.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleS3.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestKmsKey

  ############################################################
  # DMS
  ############################################################

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Service role that allows AWS DMS to manage VPC resources for the test environment
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupIdentifier: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dms-subnet-group'
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: Replication subnet group for Service Catalog DMS preventive control tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################
  # ElastiCache
  ############################################################

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cache-subnet-group'

      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ElastiCacheCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup

      Description: Cache security group for ElastiCache preventive control tests
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################

        Statement:

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: ServiceCatalogPreventiveControls
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
