AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform. Turns a plain language marketing
  instruction into a delivered multi channel customer campaign using Step Functions,
  Python Lambda functions, Amazon Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, an HTTP API secured by
  Cognito, and optional OpenSearch Serverless semantic search.

Parameters:
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
    Description: Amazon Bedrock foundation model identifier used by the generative pipeline stages.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    Description: Email address subscribed to the operational alerts topic (confirmation required).
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.

  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: '+10000000000'
    Description: Placeholder messaging phone number identifier used by the delivery stage.
    AllowedPattern: '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an E.164 formatted phone number identifier.

  OriginationNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: '+10000000000'
    Description: Placeholder origination number used as the sender for messaging channels.
    AllowedPattern: '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an E.164 formatted phone number.

  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When true, an OpenSearch Serverless vector collection is created for semantic search.

Conditions:
  EnableSemanticSearchCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableSemanticSearch
    - 'true'

Resources:

  CampaignKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key protecting AI campaign orchestration data stores
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  CampaignKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/campaign-orchestration
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-customer-profiles
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-channel-rate-limits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: window
          KeyType: RANGE
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: window
          AttributeType: S
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  MessageDeliveryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-message-delivery
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: campaignId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: CampaignIdIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: campaignId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: CustomerIdIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: customerId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLSRequests
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

  PipelineLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: campaign-pipeline-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the AI campaign orchestration pipeline functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipelineDataStoreAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Sid: CampaignAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: EncryptionKeyUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
              - Sid: GenerativeModelInvocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}'

  CampaignLauncherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: campaign-launcher-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the campaign launcher function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartCampaignExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartStateMachine
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Ref CampaignStateMachine
              - Sid: ReadCampaignSession
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:execution:${CampaignStateMachine}:*'

  CampaignStatusRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: campaign-status-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the campaign status function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadCampaignStatus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadDeliveryAndProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
              - Sid: DecryptCampaignData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn

  DeliveryCallbackRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: campaign-delivery-callback-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the delivery status callback function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateDeliveryStatus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UpdateDeliveryRecords
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
              - Sid: DecryptCampaignData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: campaign-state-machine-role
      Description: Execution role for the AI campaign orchestration state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokePipelineFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePipelineLambdas
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Tracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-parse-instruction
      Description: Parses a plain language marketing instruction into a structured plan
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          bedrock = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")


          def handler(event, context):
              instruction = event.get("instruction", "")
              body = {
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 512,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": instruction}],
              }
              response = bedrock.invoke_model(
                  modelId=os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"],
                  contentType="application/json",
                  accept="application/json",
                  body=json.dumps(body),
              )
              parsed = json.loads(response["body"].read())
              return {
                  "instruction": instruction,
                  "parsed": parsed,
                  "campaignId": event.get("campaignId", ""),
              }

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-segment-customers
      Description: Segments target customers from the customer profile store
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
          SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ENDPOINT: !If
            - EnableSemanticSearchCondition
            - !GetAtt SemanticSearchCollection.CollectionEndpoint
            - ''
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")


          def handler(event, context):
              table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ["PROFILES_TABLE"])
              items = table.scan(Limit=200).get("Items", [])
              return {
                  "instruction": event.get("instruction", ""),
                  "parsed": event.get("parsed", {}),
                  "campaignId": event.get("campaignId", ""),
                  "segments": items,
                  "semanticSearchEndpoint": os.environ.get("SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ENDPOINT", ""),
              }

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-predict-channel
      Description: Predicts the best delivery channel for each segmented customer
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")


          def handler(event, context):
              predictions = []
              for customer in event.get("segments", []):
                  customer_id = customer.get("customerId")
                  preferred = customer.get("preferredChannel", "email")
                  predictions.append(
                      {
                          "customerId": customer_id,
                          "channel": preferred,
                      }
                  )
              return {
                  "campaignId": event.get("campaignId", ""),
                  "instruction": event.get("instruction", ""),
                  "parsed": event.get("parsed", {}),

  SafetyCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-safety-check
      Description: Runs a safety check over the generated campaign content
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          BLOCKED_TERMS = ["guaranteed", "risk-free", "miracle"]


          def handler(event, context):
              predictions = event.get("predictions", [])
              flagged = []
              for prediction in predictions:
                  text = json.dumps(prediction).lower()
                  for term in BLOCKED_TERMS:
                      if term in text:
                          flagged.append({"customerId": prediction.get("customerId"), "term": term})
              return {
                  "campaignId": event.get("campaignId", ""),
                  "parsed": event.get("parsed", {}),
                  "predictions": predictions,
                  "safetyPassed": len(flagged) == 0,
                  "flagged": flagged,
              }

  AdaptContentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-adapt-content
      Description: Adapts approved campaign content for each delivery channel
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          bedrock = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")


          def handler(event, context):
              messages = []
              for prediction in event.get("predictions", []):
                  channel = prediction.get("channel", "email")
                  prompt = "Write a short {0} marketing message.".format(channel)
                  body = {
                      "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                      "max_tokens": 256,
                      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                  }
                  response = bedrock.invoke_model(
                      modelId=os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"],
                      contentType="application/json",
                      accept="application/json",
                      body=json.dumps(body),
                  )
                  content = json.loads(response["body"].read())
                  messages.append(
                      {
                          "customerId": prediction.get("customerId"),
                          "channel": channel,
                          "content": content,
                      }
                  )
              return {
                  "campaignId": event.get("campaignId", ""),
                  "safetyPassed": event.get("safetyPassed", False),
                  "messages": messages,
              }

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-deliver-messages
      Description: Delivers the adapted messages and records delivery tracking rows
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable

          NOTIFICATION_EMAIL: !Ref NotificationEmail
          MESSAGING_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          ORIGINATION_NUMBER: !Ref OriginationNumber
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")


          def handler(event, context):
              table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ["DELIVERY_TABLE"])
              campaign_id = event.get("campaignId", "")
              delivered = []
              for message in event.get("messages", []):
                  message_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  table.put_item(
                      Item={
                          "messageId": message_id,
                          "campaignId": campaign_id,
                          "customerId": message.get("customerId", ""),

  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-launcher
      Description: Starts a campaign orchestration execution from an HTTP request
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CampaignLauncherRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3

          sfn = boto3.client("stepfunctions")


          def handler(event, context):
              body = {}
              if isinstance(event, dict):
                  raw = event.get("body")
                  if raw:
                      body = json.loads(raw)
                      if isinstance(body, str):
                          body = json.loads(body)
              campaign_id = body.get("campaignId") or str(uuid.uuid4())
              response = sfn.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"],
                  name=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                  input=json.dumps(
                      {
                          "instruction": body.get("instruction", ""),
                          "campaignId": campaign_id,
                      }
                  ),
              )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 202,
                  "body": json.dumps(
                      {
                          "campaignId": campaign_id,
                          "executionArn": response["executionArn"],
                      }
                  ),
              }

  CampaignStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-status
      Description: Returns the delivery status of a campaign
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CampaignStatusRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")


          def handler(event, context):
              path_params = {}
              if isinstance(event, dict):
                  path_params = event.get("pathParameters") or {}
              campaign_id = path_params.get("id", "")
              table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ["DELIVERY_TABLE"])
              result = table.query(
                  IndexName="CampaignIdIndex",
                  KeyConditionExpression=Key("campaignId").eq(campaign_id),
              )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps(
                      {
                          "campaignId": campaign_id,
                          "items": result.get("Items", []),
                      },
                      default=str,
                  ),
              }

  DeliveryStatusCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-delivery-status-callback
      Description: Processes delivery status callbacks from channel providers
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DeliveryCallbackRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")


          def handler(event, context):
              table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ["DELIVERY_TABLE"])
              payload = event
              if isinstance(event, dict) and event.get("body"):
                  payload = json.loads(event["body"])
                  if isinstance(payload, str):
                      payload = json.loads(payload)
              message_id = payload.get("messageId") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
              status = payload.get("status", "UNKNOWN") if isinstance(payload, dict) else "UNKNOWN"
              if message_id:
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={"messageId": message_id},
                      UpdateExpression="SET #s = :s",
                      ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"},
                      ExpressionAttributeValues={":s": status},
                  )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"received": True, "messageId": message_id}),
              }

        Enabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn

        AdaptContentFunctionArn: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
        DeliverMessagesFunctionArn: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
        RecordResultsFunctionArn: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "AI campaign orchestration pipeline",
          "StartAt": "ParseInstruction",
          "States": {
            "ParseInstruction": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${ParseInstructionFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.parseResult",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ],
              "Next": "SegmentCustomers"
            },
            "SegmentCustomers": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${SegmentCustomersFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.segmentResult",
              "Next": "PredictChannel"
            },
            "PredictChannel": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${PredictChannelFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.predictResult",
              "Next": "SafetyCheck"
            },
            "SafetyCheck": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${SafetyCheckFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.safetyResult",
              "Next": "AdaptContent"
            },
            "AdaptContent": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${AdaptContentFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.adaptResult",
              "Next": "DeliverMessages"
            },
            "DeliverMessages": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${DeliverMessagesFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.deliverResult",
              "Next": "RecordResults"
            },
            "RecordResults": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${RecordResultsFunctionArn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.recordResult",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
